requirements.text: When high forces are required, the lever handle shall be located between waist and shoulder levels; force typically applied pulling.

values.condition: between user's waist height and shoulder height

requirements.site_hook: Compare lever handle height with mannequin waist and shoulder (acromion) heights for P5 female and P95 male in the working posture
requirements.percentile_rule: between waist and shoulder levels of the user population (check P5 and P95)

requirements.title: Lever detents and non-slip handles
requirements.text: Selector levers have mechanical detents coinciding precisely with panel markings; handles provide sufficient friction (serrations/knurling).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Pedal use
requirements.text: Pedals used only where hands occupied, force too high for hands, or stereotype (clutch, brake, accelerator, rudder).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Pedal location reach
requirements.text: Pedals shall be located so the user can easily reach them without extreme stretching or torso twisting and can also reach the maximally-displaced pedals (see figure 21).
requirements.site_hook: Seated mannequin (P5 female) IK foot to pedal at full displacement without pelvis slide/twist; P95 male knee clearance at undisplaced pedal
requirements.percentile_rule: multivariate central 90% (95% preferred) of clothed/equipped males and of females of target population

requirements.title: Pedal dimensions, displacement, resistance, separation
requirements.text: H height min 25 mm (1 in); W width min 75 mm (3 in). Displacement: normal operation 13 mm (0.5 in) to 65 mm (2.5 in); heavy boots 25 mm (1 in) to 65 mm (2.5 in); ankle flexion 25 mm (1 in) to 65 mm (2.5 in); total leg movement 25 mm (1 in) to 180 mm (7 in). Resistance: foot not resting on pedal 18 N (4 lb) to 90 N (20 lb); foot resting on pedal 45 N (10 lb) to 90 N (20 lb); ankle flexion only max 45 N (10 lb); total leg movement 45 N (10 lb) to 800 N (180 lb). Separation S: one foot random 100 mm (4 in) to 150 mm (6 in); one foot sequential 50 mm (2 in) to 100 mm (4 in). Diagram shows pedal angle 'MAXIMUM 60 DEG' from floor.
requirements.site_hook: New pedal object (W, H, travel, angle, force); separation between pedal edges; compare total-leg force with P5 leg push from Figure 22

requirements.title: Pedal location accommodation
requirements.text: Pedal location shall accommodate the multivariate central 90 percent (95 percent preferred) of suitably clothed and equipped males and females of the target user population.
requirements.site_hook: Run pedal reach for boundary mannequins (P5 female to P95 male, or multivariate cases)
requirements.percentile_rule: multivariate central 90% (95% preferred) of clothed/equipped males and of females of target population

requirements.title: Pedal foot and heel placement
requirements.text: Pedals that may be held or must be adjusted (accelerator, clutch) shall be located so the user can rest the heel on the floor while articulating the ankle/foot; if heel cannot rest on the floor and pedal angle is more than 20 degrees from the horizontal floor, a heel rest shall be provided (5.1.4.2.2.2.2.4).

values.quantity: pedal angle from horizontal above which heel rest needed
values.condition: if heel cannot rest on floor

requirements.site_hook: Check heel point on floor with ball of foot on pedal (ankle angle within ROM); pedal angle parameter

requirements.title: Pedal return, resistance, travel path
requirements.text: Pedals return to null without assistance (except continuous-output e.g. rudder); sufficient resistance so foot weight does not actuate where the foot rests; travel path compatible with natural articulation of thigh, knee, ankle (5.1.4.2.2.2.5).
requirements.site_hook: Sweep pedal travel and check foot path vs IK-feasible path

requirements.title: High-force pedal aids and knee angle
requirements.text: When high forces are required, aids shall be provided: a. seat backrest; b. double-width pedal for both feet; c. optimized seat height-to-pedal and reach where the seat reference point and pedal are at the same height and the angle between upper thigh and lower leg is approximately 160 degrees (figure 22).

values.quantity: knee angle (thigh to lower leg) for max force
values.condition: approximately; SRP and pedal at same height

requirements.site_hook: Seated mannequin with foot on pedal: measure knee included angle (target ~160°) and vertical offset SRP-to-pedal; check backrest present

requirements.title: Leg strength vs knee and thigh angle (5th percentile male)
requirements.text: Graph of 5th percentile maximum push (N) vs knee angle β (60-180°) for thigh angle α groups: 1 = -15° to 6°, 2 = +5° to 10°, 3 = 15° to 19°, 4 = 33° to 36°, 5 = 48° to 49°. Maximum push occurs at about 160° knee angle (limiting angle); highest curve peaks at roughly 2,300 N near 160°, other curves peak roughly 1,100-1,600 N; values drop sharply toward knee straight (180°). Curve-by-curve values could not be read reliably from the rendered graph and must be digitized from the PDF before use. Women approximately 52 percent (upper body) and 66 percent (lower body) as strong as men (NOTE).

values.quantity: limiting knee angle for max push

requirements.site_hook: Digitize curves; given mannequin thigh angle and knee angle at pedal, look up allowable push and compare to pedal force (x2/3 for females)
requirements.percentile_rule: 5th percentile male; two-thirds for females

requirements.title: High-force pedal strength accommodation
requirements.text: High-force application aids shall be operable with two-thirds of male strength (figure 22) to accommodate the female population; high-force pedals non-skid (5.1.4.2.2.2.8).

values.quantity: design strength fraction of P5 male

requirements.site_hook: Required pedal force <= 2/3 x Figure 22 value at the mannequin's knee/thigh angles
requirements.percentile_rule: two-thirds of 5th percentile male strength

requirements.title: High-force controls: within weakest user strength
requirements.text: Controls requiring forces exceeding the strength limits of the lowest segment of the expected user population shall not be used; only with proper body/limb support (5.1.4.3.1.1); sustained high force (> 3 seconds) avoided (5.1.4.3.1.2).
requirements.site_hook: User enters required force and duration; compare to P5 (female-adjusted) strength from Figure 23/22; check seat backrest/foot support present
requirements.percentile_rule: lowest segment of expected user population (P5, female-adjusted)

requirements.title: High-force foot controls
requirements.text: Push force depends on thigh and knee angle; figure 22 gives maximum push; max at about 160-degree limiting angle; values apply to males and shall be corrected for females (two-thirds of each value).
requirements.site_hook: Use mannequin knee/thigh angles + Figure 22 lookup
requirements.percentile_rule: 5th percentile male x 2/3 for females

requirements.title: Arm strength by shoulder angle (5th percentile male)
requirements.site_hook: Look up allowed force by mannequin shoulder flexion angle and force direction (from posture), hand side; x2/3 for females; compare user-entered control force
requirements.percentile_rule: 5th percentile male; two-thirds for females

requirements.title: Hand grip and pinch strength (5th percentile male)
requirements.text: Hand grip: momentary hold L 250 N (56 lbf), R 260 N (59 lbf); sustained hold L 145 N (33), R 155 N (35). Palmer pinch (thumb pad to index & middle finger pads): momentary 60 N (13), sustained 35 N (8). Tip pinch (thumb tip to index finger): momentary 60 N (13), sustained 35 N (8). Correct for females (two-thirds).
requirements.site_hook: User enters grip/pinch force; compare with value x2/3 for females
requirements.percentile_rule: 5th percentile male; two-thirds for females

requirements.title: High-torque J-handle dimensions
requirements.text: L length 95 mm (3.75 in) to 150 mm (6 in); C clearance 32 mm (1.25 in) to 50 mm (2 in); W width 16 mm (0.65 in) to 25 mm (1 in); A displacement ±24° min to ±60° max; resistance min 0.7 N·m (6 in-lbf), max 0.14 N·m (12 in-lbf) [as printed; max smaller than min, likely 1.4 N·m].

values.condition: as printed; max likely 1.4 N·m (12 in-lbf)

requirements.site_hook: J-handle object parameters

requirements.title: J-handle low torque, placement, coding
requirements.text: Low-torque J-handles (less than 0.7 N·m [6 in-lbf]) may have flattened/flared tip and less clearance; J-handles serving different critical functions not placed next to each other or in mirrored left/right locations; shape, size, texture, color differences used.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Miniature controls use
requirements.text: Miniature controls should be used only when severe space limitations exist; shall not be used when space allows standard controls or when heavy gloves or mittens will be worn.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Miniature controls dimensions, resistance, displacement
requirements.text: Dimensions and separation of miniature controls shall be the maximum permitted by available space up to the maxima for standard controls; resistance and displacement shall conform to standard-size criteria (5.1.5.3); labeling and orientation per standard-size control (5.1.5.4).
requirements.site_hook: Apply the standard-control table to miniature controls for resistance/displacement

requirements.title: Eye/head controls: vibration and precision
requirements.text: Eye- and head-based controls shall not be used in vibrating environments, nor if the task requires frequent precise head movements (5.1.6.3).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Eye/head controls dwell and response time
requirements.text: Line-of-sight dwell times shall be not greater than 300 milliseconds (less preferred); system response time not greater than 100 milliseconds (faster preferred) (5.1.6.5).
requirements.site_hook: Not geometric

requirements.title: Display face flush with panel
requirements.text: The face of a display should be flush with the surface of the panel in which it is installed.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item; display object could carry a 'recess depth' parameter (0 = flush)

requirements.title: Display/user vibration not degrading performance
requirements.text: Visual display vibration or user vibration shall not degrade performance below that required for mission accomplishment (see 5.5.5).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item linked to 5.5.5 vibration limits

requirements.title: Maximum motion speed of graphic display items
requirements.text: Graphic display items shall not move faster than 60 degrees (1.05 radians [rad]) (20 degrees [0.35 rad] preferred) of visual angle per second.

values.quantity: angular speed of moving display item

requirements.site_hook: User enters on-screen item speed (mm/s); site converts to deg/s using the eye-to-display distance

requirements.title: Orientation reference of displayed objects
requirements.text: Displays shall include reference to the vertical or horizontal direction (e.g., 'North' or 'straight ahead'); orientation of objects relative to each other shall provide cues concerning the objects depicted and object dynamics.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Display location: legible from operating/servicing position
requirements.text: Displays shall be located and arranged so that display content is legible from the user's operating or servicing position. Also see 5.10.3 (general workstation) and 5.10.3.14 (primary and secondary displays in sit-stand workstations and consoles).
requirements.site_hook: For the mannequin in its operating posture, compute eye-to-display distance and viewing angle, then check character size (5.4.7.1/Table XVIII/5.17.18.2) and off-axis angle limits; flag displays beyond legibility distance

requirements.title: Display visually accessible without ladders/flashlights
requirements.text: Visual displays shall be visually accessible without resorting to use of ladders, flashlights, or other special equipment to read the display. For display mounting requirements see 5.10.3.9.1.5 (seated) and 5.10.3.8.2.5 (standing).
requirements.site_hook: Check display lies within the visual field of the P5 mannequin from its working posture without climbing (display height vs standing/sitting eye height, line of sight not occluded); lighting part is manual
requirements.percentile_rule: smallest user (e.g. P5 female) must see display from normal posture

requirements.title: Display face angle to normal line of sight
requirements.text: Display faces shall be not less than 45 degrees (0.79 radians) from the normal line of sight (see figure 2). Display faces should be perpendicular to the user's normal line of sight.

values.quantity: angle between display face and normal line of sight

requirements.site_hook: Sandbox display normal vs ray from mannequin eye to display centre; normal line of sight = 15 deg below horizontal (Figure 2). Report face-to-LOS angle; fail < 45 deg, warn < 90 deg
requirements.percentile_rule: check at eye points of both P5 female and P95 male

requirements.title: Display orientation adjustability range
requirements.text: Where mission and environmental conditions permit it, display faces may be designed to be adjustable by the user within the constraints of 45 to 90 degrees from the normal line of sight (see figure 2).

values.quantity: adjustable display face angle to normal line of sight

requirements.site_hook: Sandbox display tilt parameter; check the tilt range keeps 45-90 deg to the LOS for each percentile eye point

requirements.title: Display luminance adjustment range
requirements.text: The display luminance adjustability (highest to lowest) range shall be not less than 50:1.
requirements.site_hook: User enters display max/min luminance on the display object

requirements.title: Minimum display luminance capability
requirements.text: The display shall be capable of luminance levels of at least 35 cd/m² (10 fL).
requirements.site_hook: Display object luminance parameter

requirements.title: Luminance adjustable to zero
requirements.text: If required by the mission, display luminance shall be adjustable to zero.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Hoods/shields against ambient illumination
requirements.text: Hoods, shields, or other methods shall be used to prevent ambient illumination from degrading the visibility of a display.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item; display object could carry an optional hood

requirements.title: Display contrast over ambient range
requirements.text: Display contrast shall be such that the display content is visible over the entire range of the expected ambient illumination.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Prevent disruptive display reflections (e.g. onto windshields)
requirements.text: All reflections of the display that may disrupt operations, such as reflections onto windshields, shall be prevented (construction, arrangement, mounting, shields, filters, anti-reflective coatings, luminance/contrast adjustment, reverse video).
requirements.site_hook: With a windshield/window object, mirror-reflect display position in the window plane and test whether the reflected image falls in the mannequin's forward line of sight

requirements.title: Specular reflection limit
requirements.text: Light from an external source creating a specular reflection on a display shall not exceed 1.0 percent of the display luminance for a viewing angle of 30 degrees or less from the display normal.

values.quantity: specular reflection luminance as % of display luminance
values.condition: viewing angle <= 30 deg from display normal

requirements.site_hook: Needs light-source objects and display reflectance data; the site can compute the viewing angle from the display normal

requirements.title: Diffuse reflection limit
requirements.text: Light from an external source creating a diffuse reflection on a display shall not exceed 0.2 percent for a viewing angle of 30 degrees or less from the display normal or across the expected range of operator viewing angles, whichever is larger.

values.condition: viewing angle <= 30 deg from display normal or the operator viewing-angle range, whichever larger

requirements.site_hook: User enters reflection data; site supplies the range of viewing angles across percentiles

requirements.title: No polarized/tinted display surfaces for glare
requirements.text: Neither polarized nor tinted display surfaces shall be used to reduce glare or reflection.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Daylight-readable display luminance
requirements.text: Displays intended for use in daylight (up to about 25,000 lux) shall have sufficient luminance to meet the contrast requirements in 5.2.2.7.

values.quantity: design ambient illuminance for daylight displays

requirements.site_hook: User enters display luminance and reflectance; compute contrast at 25,000 lux

requirements.title: Dimmers in variable ambient illumination
requirements.text: When a display is used in a variable ambient illumination environment, controls (dimmers) shall be installed on all displays (e.g., illuminated panels, indicators, or switches) in the immediate area.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Illumination uniformity for a group of displays
requirements.text: External illumination of a group of displays shall not vary more than 3:1 between the brightest and the darkest area.

values.quantity: brightest:darkest external illumination across display group

requirements.site_hook: User enters illuminance measurements per display

requirements.title: Display visible with CBRNE/PPE
requirements.text: Display illumination shall be designed so that display content is visible when CBRNE or other mission-required PPE equipment is used. 5.2.1.8.1: where laser eye protection (LEP) may be worn, the color palette shall be assessed for compatibility with the LEP.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item; PPE visor could later modify eye-point/field of view

requirements.title: Night vision device compatibility
requirements.text: Where night vision device compatibility is required, displays shall be in accordance with MIL-STD-3009.
requirements.site_hook: External standard

requirements.title: Blackout discipline
requirements.text: Where operational security or survivability requires blackout discipline, permanently illuminated outdoor displays shall be avoided and illumination of displays within personnel enclosures shall automatically switch off when doors to the enclosure are opened (5.2.1.9.2.1: blackout lighting per MIL-STD-1179).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Display top lower than window (dark adaptation)

requirements.title: Field-use panel dimming levels
requirements.text: When visual displays are viewed out of doors at night: maximum display illumination at the full ON position of table XII; no panel lighting current at the full OFF position of table XII; panel light levels continuously variable from 0.1 cd/m² (0.03 fL) near OFF to 3.5 cd/m² (1 fL) at 50 percent position of control.
requirements.site_hook: User enters dimmer curve

requirements.title: Control positions for full OFF and full ON illumination
requirements.text: Rotary knob/selector: OFF full counterclockwise, ON full clockwise. Horizontal slider/thumbwheel/lever: OFF full left, ON full right. Vertical slider/thumbwheel/lever: OFF full down, ON full up.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist; could be a property of a dimmer control object

requirements.title: One-third hood with rounded corners

requirements.text: When dark adaptation is required, all displays shall face away from windows to prevent all specular reflections.

requirements.title: Ambient light level for dark adaptation

values.condition: night, overhead lighting off; 0.0001 lx should

requirements.title: Low-level blue-filtered white lighting
requirements.text: Low-level blue-filtered white color light shall be used for panel, display, task, and backlit keyboard lighting in accordance with SAE AS25050 (also see 5.5.3).
requirements.site_hook: External standard

requirements.text: The combined effects of all geometric distortion shall not displace any point on the display from its correct position by more than 5 percent of the picture height.

values.quantity: point displacement as % of picture height

requirements.site_hook: Display spec entry

requirements.site_hook: User enters jitter in mm; convert to visual angle with eye-to-display distance

requirements.title: Flicker controls
requirements.text: Electronic visual displays shall include controls for refresh rate and other parameters (e.g., luminance, contrast, or color) to prevent flicker.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Luminance uniformity
requirements.text: Luminance across the display (blank screen) shall not vary by more than 2:1 (ratio of maximum to minimum luminance); 1.5:1 is preferred.
requirements.site_hook: Display spec entry

requirements.title: Color uniformity
requirements.text: The display shall provide color uniformity of r less than 0.030 over the display's viewing envelope, where r is the radius of the allowable circular area on the 1976 UCS chromaticity diagram for the specified color.
requirements.site_hook: Display spec entry; the site supplies the viewing envelope

requirements.title: Image polarity vs ambient light

values.condition: below ~0.1 lx use light-on-dark; otherwise dark-on-light

requirements.site_hook: User selects ambient condition and polarity

requirements.title: Character-to-background contrast ratio
requirements.text: The contrast ratio between characters and a background shall be 6:1 or greater (10:1 or greater is preferred). Ship bridge displays see 5.18; cockpit displays see MIL-HDBK-87213; a control shall be provided to vary contrast; large-screen displays see 5.2.2.12.
requirements.site_hook: Display object contrast parameter

requirements.title: Display class by diagonal size

Diagonal <= 16 cm (6.3 in) handheld/wearable PEDs (5.2.2.9); > 12.7 cm (5 in) and <= 33 cm (13 in) small-screen (5.2.2.10); > 33 cm (13 in) and <= 81.28 cm (32 in) individual displays (5.2.2.11); > 81.28 cm (32 in) multiple viewer direct view (5.2.2.12); optical projection (5.2.2.13).

values.condition: 10 min min, 15 min preferred, at greatest viewing distance

requirements.title: Sans serif under adverse conditions

values.condition: 28 in; seated user; display close to its associated controls

requirements.percentile_rule: seated user eye reference point; check P5-P95 seat positions

values.quantity: display diagonal at 70 cm viewing distance
line of sight off perpendicular at display corners

requirements.title: Viewing distance from ejection seat

requirements.title: Minimum viewing distance

requirements.title: Reduced viewing distance for dim signals

requirements.title: Long viewing distance (> 50 cm)
requirements.text: Displays that must be viewed from greater than 50 cm (20 in) should be modified in characteristics such as display size, symbol size, luminance, and resolution to be visible at longer distances. Alphanumeric characters shall conform to the requirements of 5.17.18.2 (>= 2.9 mrad (10 min), should be >= 4.5 mrad (15 min)).
requirements.site_hook: Compute minimum character height = distance x tan(angle) and report it

requirements.title: Large-screen display observational geometry

requirements.title: Large-screen viewing distance to diagonal ratio

requirements.site_hook: Eye-to-screen distance / screen diagonal for each viewer

requirements.title: Maximum viewing distance for large-screen displays

values.quantity: character height visual angle at most distant viewer

requirements.site_hook: Max viewing distance = char height / tan(2.9 mrad) for the most distant viewer

requirements.title: Minimum viewing distance for large-screen displays
requirements.text: The display shall not be closer to any observer than one-half the display width or height, whichever is greater.
requirements.site_hook: Compare eye distance with 0.5 x max(display width, height)

requirements.title: Large-screen view not obscured by traffic
requirements.text: A large-screen display shall be located with respect to critical observers so that the view of the display is not obscured regularly by persons moving in normal traffic patterns.

requirements.title: Separate display for individual changes
requirements.text: When individuals must make changes that are of interest only to themselves, a separate display shall be provided.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Direct-view large-screen luminance contrast
requirements.text: The luminance contrast for direct-view large-screen displays shall be not less than 1.5:1. requirements.title: Avoid front projection with obstructions

requirements.text: The viewing distance/image width relationship of optical projection displays for group viewing should conform to the preferred limits of table XIII and shall not exceed the acceptable limits. requirements.site_hook: Eye-to-screen distance / diagonal for each viewer seat

requirements.title: Projection angle off centerline (Table XIII)

requirements.site_hook: Angle between eye-to-screen-centre ray and screen normal per viewer

requirements.title: Projection image luminance and distribution (Table XIII)
requirements.text: Image luminance and light distribution shall conform to the preferred limits and shall not exceed the acceptable limits of table XIII. Image luminance (no film in operating projector): optimum 35 cd/m², preferred 27 to 48 cd/m², acceptable 17 to 70 cd/m² (higher values may be used for still projections). Luminance variation across screen (max/min): optimum 1.0, preferred 1.5, acceptable 3.0. Luminance variation as a function of viewing location (max/min): optimum 1.0, preferred 2.0, acceptable 4.0. Ratio of ambient light to the brightest part of the image: optimum 0, preferred 0.002 to 0.01, acceptable 0.1 maximum (0.2 may be used for presentations not involving gray scale or color).

values.condition: preferred 0.002 to 0.01; 0.2 allowed for line drawings/tables

requirements.site_hook: User enters photometric data

requirements.title: Screen centre luminance at maximum viewing angle
requirements.text: The screen center luminance at the maximum viewing angle shall be at least half its maximum luminance.

values.quantity: centre luminance at max viewing angle / max luminance

requirements.site_hook: Site supplies the maximum viewing angle across seats; user enters screen gain curve

requirements.title: Luminance ratio of optical projection displays
requirements.text: Luminance ratio (5.2.2.13.8): optimal ambient lighting conditions 500:1; viewing charts, printed text, and other line work not less than 5:1; animation and photographs with limited luminance range not less than 25:1; images with a full range of colors (or grays) not less than 100:1.
requirements.site_hook: User enters content type and measured ratio

requirements.title: Projected character stroke width
requirements.text: Stroke width shall be 0.1667 to 0.125 of numeral or letter height but may be narrower for light markings on a dark background. Stroke width shall be the same for all letters and numerals of equal height. (5.2.2.13.9.3: letter width, numeral width, character spacing and word spacing per 5.4.7.6.1, 5.4.7.6.2, 5.4.7.8, 5.4.7.9.)
requirements.site_hook: Label/text object with stroke-width parameter

requirements.title: Keystone effects
requirements.text: The projector-screen arrangement should minimize keystone effects (distortion due to non-perpendicularity between projector and screen).
requirements.site_hook: If a projector object exists: angle between projector axis and screen normal

requirements.title: Depth range of 3-D displays
requirements.text: The depth range of a display shall be limited to ±0.75 diopters in front or behind the display. (5.2.2.14.1.3: temporal modulation of stereopsis approximately 1 hertz for dynamic displays.)
requirements.site_hook: With eye-to-display distance D (m), the allowed virtual depth is 1/(1/D +/- 0.75); compute and report

requirements.title: Stereo pair tolerances
requirements.text: Vertical misalignment or tilt of one optical axis shall not exceed 10 minutes of arc (5.2.2.14.3); rotational differences shall not exceed a vertical misalignment of 10 minutes of arc (5.2.2.14.4); horizontal or vertical stereo-pair image size differences shall not exceed 1.5 percent and the resulting vertical misalignment 10 minutes of arc (5.2.2.14.5); luminance differences between stereo pairs shall not exceed 30 percent (5.2.2.14.6).
requirements.site_hook: Display spec entry

requirements.title: HUD windshield transmission
requirements.text: If a vehicle windshield is used as a HUD combiner, the total transmission through the windshield shall be not less than 70 percent as measured along the line of sight.
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: HUD eye-box size
requirements.text: Regardless of the optical display technology, the head motion box or eye-size box shall be not less than 11.5 cm (4.5 in) wide, 6.5 cm (2.5 in) high, and 15 cm (6 in) deep.
requirements.site_hook: Compute spread of seated eye points across the target population (P5F-P95M with seat adjustment) and check they fit within a user-placed eye box of at least these dimensions
requirements.percentile_rule: eye box should contain eye positions of the accommodated range

requirements.title: HUD object angular displacement
requirements.text: The angular displacement of objects viewed through the combining glass assembly shall be not greater than 0.5 milliradian (1.7 minutes) of visual angle.
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: HUD apparent image focus distance (land vehicles)
requirements.text: The apparent image focus distance of HUDs for a land-based vehicle application shall be equal to the approximate distance of the driver from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.site_hook: Measure driver eye to vehicle front in the vehicle scene; compare to user-entered HUD focus distance

requirements.title: HUD field of view (land vehicles)
requirements.text: HUDs used on land-based vehicle applications shall have a field of view not less than 6 degrees (105 milliradians) above the horizontal, 5 degrees (87 milliradians) below the horizontal, and 12 degrees (209 milliradians) to the left and right.
requirements.site_hook: With a HUD combiner object: compute angular extents of the combiner from the driver eye point

requirements.title: HUD exit pupil
requirements.text: HUDs shall have a minimum exit pupil of 72 mm (2.8 in).
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry; compare with eye-position spread

requirements.title: HUD alphanumeric character height
requirements.text: The height for HUD alphanumeric characters shall be not less than 8.1 milliradians (28 minutes) of visual angle.
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry (HUD symbols are collimated, so angle is entered directly)

requirements.title: HUD non-alphanumeric character height
requirements.text: The height for HUD non-alphanumeric characters shall be not less than 9.9 milliradians (34 minutes) of visual angle.
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: HUD raster lines per symbol height
requirements.text: For head-up raster displays, alphanumeric characters shall not use less than 16 raster lines/symbol height; non-alphanumeric characters shall use not less than 20 raster lines/symbol height (5.2.2.15.9.4).

values.quantity: raster lines per alphanumeric symbol height
raster lines per non-alphanumeric symbol height

requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: HUD symbol luminance in sunlight
requirements.text: When legibility in direct sunlight or background luminance of 34,000 cd/m² (9,920 fL) or greater is required, symbol luminance shall be not less than 50,000 cd/m² (14,600 fL). 5.2.2.15.9.5.2: for most high ambient light applications, symbol luminance shall be 6,900 to 10,300 cd/m² (2,010 to 3,000 fL). Symbol luminance shall be adjustable (5.2.2.15.9.6).
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: HUD symbol line width
requirements.text: The line width of symbols used in HUDs shall be not less than 0.5 milliradians (1.7 minutes). For most applications, symbol line width shall be 1±0.2 milliradian (3.4±0.7 minutes).
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: HMD symbol location relative to normal line of sight
requirements.text: Information shall be capable of being displayed within 25 degrees (0.44 radians) of the normal line of sight, which is typically 15 degrees (0.265 rad) below horizontal.

values.quantity: symbol angular distance from normal line of sight
normal line of sight below horizontal

requirements.site_hook: Cone of 25 deg around the eye ray 15 deg below horizontal; same cone can test head-down display positions

requirements.title: HMD gray shades
requirements.text: Monochromatic HMDs shall provide not less than six shades of gray for alphanumeric and simple graphic information (5.2.2.16.2) and for complex graphic or sensor data (5.2.2.16.3).
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: HMD unrestricted view
requirements.text: Users shall have an unobstructed view of all displays, controls, and the real-world environment as necessary.
requirements.site_hook: Line-of-sight occlusion check from eye point to each display/control with an HMD/helmet volume attached to the head

requirements.title: Helmet-mounted weight distribution
requirements.text: Weight distribution of helmet-mounted items shall be balanced to avoid or minimize neck strain, fatigue, and helmet movement relative to the user's head. (5.2.2.16.11.1: HMD designs shall attenuate head vibration for frequencies 10 hertz and less.)
requirements.site_hook: Helmet object with mass and CoG; compute moment about the head-neck joint (occipital condyle) vs the head CoM

requirements.title: HMD attachments/cables not restricting head motion
requirements.text: Any required external attachments shall not restrict user head or shoulder motion (5.2.2.16.11.3). The projection or exposed length of the cable shall be minimized, but the cable shall not restrict normal head movement (5.2.2.16.11.4.2).
requirements.site_hook: Run neck/shoulder ROM sweep with helmet attachments and check for collision with seat/structure

requirements.title: HMD adjustable to individual eyes
requirements.text: HMDs shall be adjustable for individual eyes to be properly aligned to the system; the HMD shall remain secure in relation to the eye during task performance (5.2.2.16.11.6); HMDs shall support left or right eye dominance (5.2.2.16.12).
requirements.site_hook: Could use interpupillary breadth from the anthropometric dataset (P5-P95) vs HMD IPD adjustment range

requirements.title: LCD backlight and viewing angle adjustable
requirements.text: Backlighting (if appropriate) and viewing angle shall be adjustable by users. 5.2.2.17.1: light characters on dark background for reflective LCDs; dark characters on light background for transmissive LCDs.
requirements.site_hook: Display object 'tilt adjustable' flag

requirements.title: LCD off-axis viewing
requirements.text: Off-axis viewing of LCDs shall be possible. Display should be clearly readable up to 45 degrees (785 milliradians) off axis.
requirements.site_hook: Angle between eye-to-display ray and display normal; warn if > 45 deg for any user (e.g. second crew member)

requirements.title: Red plasma/LED displays not near red lights
requirements.text: Red plasma displays shall not be located near red lights (5.2.2.18.4); red LEDs shall not be located near red lights (5.2.2.19.5); red LEDs/segmented displays shall not be grouped with or located adjacent to red warning lights (5.2.2.20.11).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Dot-matrix character definition
requirements.text: Dot-matrix characters that are not formed by pixels shall contain not less than 5 by 7 dots, with 7 by 9 dots preferred. If symbol rotation is required, not less than 8 by 11 dots, with 15 by 21 dots preferred (5.2.2.20.4).

values.condition: min 5x7, preferred 7x9; with rotation min 8x11, preferred 15x21

requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: Dot-matrix/segmented character visual angle
requirements.text: Alphanumeric characters and symbols shall subtend not less than 4.7 milliradians (16 minutes) of visual angle as measured from the longest anticipated viewing distance.
requirements.site_hook: Character height (display parameter) / longest eye-to-display distance across users

requirements.title: Dot-matrix characters upper case
requirements.text: Alphanumeric characters shall be upper case.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Dot-matrix/segmented display viewing angle
requirements.text: Viewing angle of dot-matrix or segmented displays shall be not more than 35 degrees off axis. The optimum viewing angle is perpendicular to the display.
requirements.site_hook: Angle between eye-to-display ray and display normal

requirements.title: Monochrome emitter colors
requirements.text: Monochrome displays shall use, in order of preference: green (555 nm), yellow (575 nm), orange (585 nm), and red (660 nm). Blue emitters shall be avoided. The color shall be visible through laser protective or other eyewear (5.2.2.20.9).

values.condition: green 555 > yellow 575 > orange 585 > red 660; no blue

requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: Indicator located with its control
requirements.text: When a transilluminated indicator is associated with a control, the indicator light shall be located so that it can be associated with the control without error.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist; proximity of indicator object to control object could be reported

requirements.title: Indicator unobstructed from viewing position
requirements.text: The transilluminated indicator light shall be unobstructed relative to the user's expected viewing position.
requirements.site_hook: Ray-cast from mannequin eye to indicator; check no occlusion by objects or the mannequin's own arm in the operating posture

requirements.title: Critical indicators within 15 deg of normal line of sight
requirements.text: For critical functions, indicators shall be located within 15 degrees of the user's normal line of sight (see figure 2).

values.quantity: angle between eye-to-indicator ray and normal line of sight

requirements.site_hook: Normal LOS = 15 deg below horizontal from eye point; compute angular offset of each critical indicator
requirements.percentile_rule: check all percentiles' eye points

requirements.title: Warning lights integrated with controls
requirements.text: Warning lights shall be integrated with their associated controls.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Transilluminated display glare limit
requirements.text: Where glare must be reduced, the luminance of transilluminated displays shall be not more than 300 percent of the surrounding luminance.
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: Contrast within indicator
requirements.text: The contrast ratio within the indicator shall be not less than 2:1 (not applicable to special sunlight-legible displays). For low ambient illumination applications, the contrast ratio shall be not less than 9:1 with background luminance less than character luminance (5.2.3.1.18).
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: Legend face in panel plane
requirements.text: The legend face shall be in the plane of the panel that houses it (not recessed). The legend face area shall accommodate the legend without requiring abbreviation (5.2.3.2.11). Stacked legends: parallax shall be minimized (5.2.3.2.9.2).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Legend light lettering
requirements.text: The size and other characteristics of lettering shall be in accordance with 5.4.7. Contrast between legend lettering and background per 5.2.2.7 (5.2.3.2.14).
requirements.site_hook: Apply 5.4.7 label-size checks to legend lights

requirements.title: Legend border width
requirements.text: There shall be a border around each legend not less than the width of the letter 'H' of the selected font.

values.quantity: legend border width / width of letter H

requirements.site_hook: Legend object with border and font size; letter H width approx 3/5 char height per 5.4.7.6.1

requirements.title: Simple indicator light spacing
requirements.text: The spacing between adjacent edges of simple round indicator light fixtures shall permit unambiguous labeling and convenient bulb removal.
requirements.site_hook: Edge-to-edge spacing could be checked against label width plus finger/fingertip breadth for bulb removal

requirements.title: Simple indicator light size and color coding
requirements.text: Simple indicator lights shall be coded per table XV (5.2.3.3.4): >=25 mm (1 in), flashing (3 to 5 Hz): red = emergency condition. >=25 mm (1 in), steady: red = master summation (system or subsystem); yellow = extreme caution (impending danger); green = master summation (system or subsystem). <=13 mm (0.5 in), steady: red = malfunction/action stopped/failure/stop action; yellow = delay/check/recheck; green = go ahead/in tolerance/acceptable/ready; white = functional or physical position/action in progress; blue = advisory.

values.condition: 1 in; flashing 3 to 5 Hz for red emergency

requirements.site_hook: Indicator object with diameter, color and flash parameters

requirements.title: Panel luminance variation on same circuit
requirements.text: Luminance variation among separate panels on the same lighting circuit shall not exceed 7:1. Panel markings shall be equally illuminated throughout the range of panel light adjustment (5.2.3.4.2.4).
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: Panel lamps accessible without disconnecting panel
requirements.text: When replaceable lamps are used for integral lighting of panel assemblies, the lamps shall be accessible without disconnecting the panel.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Scale type preferences
requirements.text: Moving-pointer fixed scales shall be used in preference to fixed-pointer moving scales (5.2.4.1.2). Where reading speed is important, circular scales shall be used in preference to horizontal or vertical scales, and horizontal in preference to vertical (5.2.4.1.3). Linear scales preferred to nonlinear (5.2.4.1.4). Numeric values on fixed scales shall increase clockwise, from left to right, or from the bottom up (5.2.4.1.5).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Scale graduation progression
requirements.text: Scale graduations shall progress by one, two, or five units or decimal multiples thereof.
requirements.site_hook: Dial object parameter check

requirements.title: Number of graduation mark sizes
requirements.text: No more than three sizes of marks (minor, intermediate, and major) shall be used on any scale (see figure 25 and figure 26). When no intermediate mark is used, no more than four minor marks shall be used (5.2.4.6.3). With intermediate marks, minor marks between numbered markers shall not exceed nine (5.2.4.6.4). Intermediate marks only when there are more than four minor marks (5.2.4.6.5).
requirements.site_hook: Dial object parameters

requirements.title: Scale marker dimensions (visual angle)
requirements.text: Dimensions of dark markers on light background, visual angle (at longest anticipated viewing distance): A width of major scale index 1.16 mrad (4 min); B width of minor scale index 0.87 mrad (3 min); C width of intermediate scale index 1.16 mrad (4 min); D length of major scale index 7.86 mrad (27 min); E length of minor scale index 3.49 mrad (12 min); F length of intermediate scale index 5.82 mrad (20 min); G width of gap between major scale index 25.02 mrad (86 min); H width of gap between minor scale index 2.62 mrad (9 min). Note 1: the minor mark width can be used for all marks with dark marks on light background. Note 2: widths A, B, C are 4.36 mrad (15 min) for light markers on dark background. Height, width and gaps shall be in accordance with figure 25 (5.2.4.6.6).
requirements.site_hook: Convert each visual angle to mm at the longest eye-to-dial distance (size = D x angle) and compare with dial object mark dimensions; useful report: 'required mark sizes at this distance'

requirements.title: Scale numeral orientation
requirements.text: On fixed scales, numerals shall be vertically oriented. For hardware rotating scales, numerals shall be radially oriented and upright when read against the pointer; software rotating scales numerals should always be oriented upwards (5.2.4.7.2). Whole numbers for major graduations (5.2.4.7.3); scale shall start at zero unless inappropriate (5.2.4.7.4).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Pointer range and obscuration
requirements.text: Scale pointers shall extend to, but not overlap, the shortest scale graduation marks. Scale markings and numbers shall be arranged to prevent pointers from covering any portion of the scale marks or numerals (5.2.4.8.2). Scale marks shall be on or close to the plane of the pointer tip to avoid parallax (5.2.4.8.2.1).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Pointer-to-scale mark gap for maximum reading accuracy
requirements.text: For maximum reading accuracy the pointer is an equal distance, nominal 0.8-1.6 mm (0.031-0.061 in), from all scale marks, never overlapping any mark or numeral. Alternate format with numerals inside the annulus for gross reading.

values.quantity: pointer tip to scale mark gap

requirements.site_hook: Dial object parameter

requirements.title: Pointer movement direction
requirements.text: Scale reading shall increase with pointer movement up or to the right (5.2.4.8.3); for +/- values, positive increases up/right and negative down/left (5.2.4.8.4); pointers to the right of vertical scales and at the bottom of horizontal scales (5.2.4.8.5); numerals on the side of graduations away from the pointer (5.2.4.8.6).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Pointer alignment in indicator groups
requirements.text: When a common stable value exists in a group of indicators, they shall be arranged in rows so all pointers line up horizontally (vertical scales) or in columns so all pointers line up vertically (horizontal scales). For circular dials, pointers line up at the 9 o'clock position (rows) or 12 o'clock (columns); in a matrix, 9 o'clock preferred (5.2.4.8.10.2).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Pointer tip taper
requirements.text: The pointer tip shall be tapered at a 20-degree angle (40-degree total included angle), terminating in a flat tip equal in width to the minor scale graduations.
requirements.site_hook: Dial object parameter

requirements.title: Scale face to markings contrast
requirements.text: A contrast ratio not less than 3:1 shall be provided between the scale face and the markings and pointer. Pointer color from tip to center same as marks; tail same as dial face (5.2.4.8.9.1-2).
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: Coaxial pointers and mounting
requirements.text: Not more than two coaxial pointers shall be mounted on one indicator face. For mechanical displays, the pointer shall be mounted as close as possible to the face of the dial to minimize parallax (5.2.4.8.10.3).
requirements.site_hook: Dial object parameter

requirements.title: Shape coding of zone scales
requirements.text: Zone scales shall be shape coded when the indicator must be viewed in blackout conditions or where the illuminant color will cause difficulty in color band discrimination (see figure 28). Red, yellow and green zones per 5.17.25.8 (5.2.4.9.3).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Circular scale zero and maximum positions
requirements.text: Where only positive values are displayed and less than 360 degrees are used, the zero or minimum value shall be in the area between 225 and 300 degrees and the maximum value in the area between 60 and 135 degrees, symmetrically arranged (0 deg = 12 o'clock, clockwise positive). For full 360 degrees or multi-turn, zero at top (0 degrees) (5.2.4.10.4). For +/- values, zero at top or at 270 degrees (12 or 9 o'clock) (5.2.4.10.5). Scale reading increases clockwise (5.2.4.10.1-2).
requirements.site_hook: Dial object start/end angles

requirements.title: Circular scale break
requirements.text: There shall be an obvious break of at least 10 degrees of arc between the two ends of the scale, except on multi-revolution instruments such as clocks.
requirements.site_hook: Dial object start/end angles

requirements.title: Arc and straight-line scale layout
requirements.text: Numerals located outside scale marks, pointers ride against the inner scale annulus just short of the markings; zero reference to the left so increasing number and pointer motion is clockwise; arc-scale null centered with positive increase right/upward; pointer shall not cover scale marks or numerals; pointer emanates from the right side of vertical formats and from the bottom of horizontal formats.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Silent night operation earphone level
requirements.text: In equipment designed for silent operation at night, the sound level at the ear under an earphone shall be not greater than 50 dBA.

values.quantity: sound level at ear under earphone

requirements.site_hook: Audio signal spec; not a geometry check

requirements.title: Warning/caution signal level above ambient
requirements.text: Warning signals shall be distinctive complex sounds at least 15 dBA above the ambient noise environment, but shall not exceed 140 dBP for overall signal sound (same for caution 5.3.2.2.3.1, alerting 5.3.2.3.2.5 and cueing 5.3.2.4.4 signals); if not achievable, other alerting methods shall be used (5.3.2.1.4).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist / spec entry

requirements.title: Advisory signal level in quiet areas
requirements.text: In quiet areas below 45 dBA, advisory signals shall be presented at a level of 50 to 70 dBA; with a noise background, at least 15 dBA above ambient in the critical band (5.3.2.4.2).
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: Warning recognition time and duration
requirements.text: Warning signals shall be unambiguously recognized as warnings within 0.5 seconds of initiation; two-element signals shall convey full meaning within 2.5 seconds (5.3.3.1.2); audio warning signal duration at least 0.5 seconds (5.3.5.12); verbal critical warnings repeated with not more than 3-second pause (5.3.5.9).
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: Warning signal frequency range
requirements.text: The frequency range shall be between 250 and 8,000 hertz and, if possible, between 500 and 2,000 hertz. Signals travelling over 300 m (985 ft): frequencies below 1,000 Hz (5.3.3.3.1.2); through obstacles: below 500 Hz (5.3.3.3.1.3).
requirements.site_hook: Audio spec

requirements.title: Maximum audio level at the ear
requirements.text: Sound pressure levels shall not exceed 115 dBA measured at the ear of the listener. A signal-to-noise ratio of at least 10 dB shall be provided in at least one octave band between 200 and 5,000 Hz at the operating position (5.3.4.1). Sound level increase during any 0.5-second period not greater than 30 dB (5.3.4.2.3).
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: Verbal alarm intensity
requirements.text: Verbal alarms for critical functions shall be not less than 20 dBA above the speech interference level at the operating position of the intended receiver, but should not exceed 140 dBP.
requirements.site_hook: Spec entry

requirements.title: Binaural headsets in high noise
requirements.text: If listeners will work in high ambient noise (85 dBA or above), binaural rather than monaural headsets shall be provided.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: PA speaker range in reverberant spaces
requirements.text: Speaker range in reverberant spaces shall be not greater than 15 m (50 ft) to avoid excessive echoing (see 5.5.4.6.3).
requirements.site_hook: Distance from a speaker object to mannequin head positions

requirements.title: 3-D audio angular separation
requirements.text: Angular separation between discrete sounds shall be not less than 15 degrees in the horizontal plane and not less than 30 degrees in the vertical plane unless indicating location of real objects or events.
requirements.site_hook: Audio spec

requirements.title: Speech display output rate
requirements.text: All speech displays shall provide an output rate between 150 and 180 words per minute.
requirements.site_hook: Audio spec

requirements.title: Speech intelligibility criteria
requirements.text: Intelligibility criteria (5.3.11.2): exceptionally high MRT 97% / AI 0.7; normal acceptable 91% / 0.5; minimally acceptable for mechanized equipment users 80% / 0.4; minimally acceptable 75% / 0.3. AI shall not be used for synthetic speech.
requirements.site_hook: Audio spec

requirements.title: Radio control panel reach without opening doors
requirements.text: Radio control panels shall be readily visible and accessible (5.3.12.3.1.2); the user shall be able to reach control panel(s) to change frequency without having to open doors or remove covers; controls usable while wearing gloves if required (5.3.12.3.1.5).
requirements.site_hook: Reach check from operator posture to radio panel object; visibility ray-cast

requirements.title: Communication control box within cable reach
requirements.text: Control boxes shall be within easy reach of standard connecting cables (760 mm [30 in]) from the operator's nominal working area; warning lights on control boxes shall be within the responsible operator's field of vision (5.3.12.5.5); control boxes shall not interfere with normal movements or be placed where likely used as footrests or steps (5.3.12.5.1-2).
