requirements.title: Safety barrier interlock
requirements.text: Safety barriers should be interlocked with operating machinery and hazardous energy sources and provide emergency shut-off when removed. Test and evaluation should be feasible with barriers in place (5.7.5.10.2). Where interlocks need to be bypassed, special precautions and warnings shall be present (5.7.5.10.3).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Equipment safety review areas
requirements.text: In evaluating equipment safety, the following shall be reviewed: failure modes and hazardous effects; electrical and electronic safety factors; mechanical safety factors incl. hydraulics and pneumatics; toxicity.
requirements.site_hook: Process requirement; not checkable by the site.

requirements.title: Interlocks and warnings for hazardous-operation controls
requirements.text: Switches or controls that initiate hazardous operations (e.g., ignition, crane movement) shall require prior operation of a related or locking control (5.7.6.1.1); where practicable their critical position shall activate a visual and auditory warning device in the affected work area (5.7.6.1.2).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Safe access to items
requirements.text: Items shall be located and mounted so that access to them can be achieved without danger to personnel from electrical, thermal, mechanical, chemical, radiological, or other hazards.
requirements.site_hook: Reach path from mannequin to target object must not intersect objects tagged as hazards.

requirements.title: Internal light on hazardous access door
requirements.text: Where access areas must be located over dangerous mechanical or electrical components, the access door or cover should be designed to turn on an internal light when opened.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Warning label in field of view on access cover
requirements.text: A warning label shall be provided on the outside of the door or cover that is within the unobstructed field of view.
requirements.site_hook: Label object placement; check line of sight from mannequin eye point to label is unobstructed.

requirements.title: Edge rounding minimum radius
requirements.text: Where applicable, all exposed edges and corners with which personnel can come into contact (including internal components accessed during maintenance) shall be rounded to a radius not less than 0.75 mm (0.03 in).
requirements.site_hook: Add edge-radius parameter to sandbox objects.

requirements.title: Sharp edges and corners radius
requirements.text: Sharp edges and corners that can present a safety hazard or cause equipment damage during regular operational usage shall be protected or rounded to a radius not less than 1.3 mm (0.05 in). In shipboard environments, motor vehicles, or other applications with a hazard of an operator falling into an edge or corner, the radius should be increased to not less than 13 mm (0.5 in).
requirements.site_hook: Edge-radius parameter on sandbox objects plus environment setting (ship/vehicle).

requirements.title: Access to safety pins and streamers
requirements.text: Personnel shall have unobstructed visual and physical access to safety pins and streamers during maintenance.
requirements.site_hook: Target object; check line of sight and hand reach from maintenance posture.

requirements.title: Handholds and footholds for climbing onto equipment
requirements.text: Handholds and footholds shall be furnished where needed to assist personnel in climbing onto equipment or performing intended tasks.
requirements.site_hook: Grab-bar objects; check reach from climbing posture (step heights vs knee height).

requirements.title: Stored energy devices safeguards
requirements.text: Devices that possess stored energy (springs, air bottles, shock absorbers, capacitors) shall contain safeguards and be labeled for safety; where feasible they shall contain provisions for emergency release of stored energy (5.7.6.8).
requirements.site_hook: Not geometric.

requirements.title: Platform locks / fail-safe
requirements.text: Self-locking or other fail-safe devices shall be incorporated on elevating stands, work platforms, and 'draw bridges' to prevent accidental or inadvertent collapsing or falling.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Handrails/safety bars/chains around platforms
requirements.text: Handrails, safety bars, or chains shall be installed around platforms and across stair or step openings on platforms, ledges, and catwalks.
requirements.site_hook: Platform object with rail flags per open side; flag open sides without rail.

requirements.title: Handrail/safety bar height on platforms
requirements.text: Handrails, safety bars, or chains shall be placed 91 to 110 cm (36 to 43 in) above the standing surface and include an intermediate guard.

values.quantity: handrail/safety bar/chain height above standing surface
values.condition: platforms, ledges, catwalks; intermediate guard required

requirements.site_hook: Rail object height relative to platform/standing surface; compare with mannequin centre-of-mass height (rail above COM) for P95/P99.

requirements.title: Chains only where rails not feasible
requirements.text: Chains should only be used where it is not feasible to install handrails or safety bars.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Kickboards on platforms
requirements.text: Kickboards that are 15 cm (6 in) high shall be installed around platforms, ledges, and catwalks.

values.condition: platforms, ledges, catwalks (printed as '15 cm (6 in) high')

requirements.site_hook: Add toe-board height parameter to platform/rail object.

requirements.title: Railing and toe-board lateral load resistance
requirements.text: Railings and toe boards shall resist lateral pressure of: top rail 900 newtons (200 lb); mid rail 450 newtons (100 lb); toe board 225 newtons (50 lb).
requirements.site_hook: Structural; checklist or user-entered rating.

requirements.title: Safety mesh under open gratings
requirements.text: Screen or safety mesh shall be installed on the underside of open gratings, platforms, or flooring where small tools, parts, or debris may fall through onto workers or equipment beneath.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Weight capacity marking
requirements.text: Weight-sharing equipment (stands, hoists, lifts, jacks) shall be marked to show weight capacity; strain gauges or equivalent should detect approach to the limit (5.7.7.5).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: High centre-of-gravity equipment stability
requirements.text: Equipment with a high center of gravity that may tip over and injure personnel shall have anchors or outriggers (5.7.7.6.1) and a warning label depicting the high CG condition pictorially or through text (5.7.7.6.2).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist (the site computes COM of the mannequin, not of equipment).

requirements.title: Guards on moving machinery parts
requirements.text: A guard shall be provided on all moving parts of machinery and transmission equipment (pulleys, belts, gears, blades) on which personnel may be injured or entangled. Guards shall require a tool to be removed (no quick-acting or hand-operated fasteners) (5.7.9.1.1); moving equipment shall be disabled while the guard is not installed (5.7.9.1.2); guards should permit inspection without removal where possible (5.7.9.1.5).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: High-temperature parts guarded or out of reach
requirements.text: High-temperature parts shall be guarded or located so users will not touch them in normal operation or maintenance; if they cannot be guarded, there shall be prominent warning signs (5.7.9.1.4).
requirements.site_hook: Hot-tagged object must be outside mannequin reach envelope in operation/maintenance postures, else guard required.

requirements.title: Guard opening size vs distance
requirements.text: The guard size opening shall be a function of the distance between the guard and the mechanical hazard (no numeric table given in this paragraph).

values.condition: function of guard-to-hazard distance; no values printed

requirements.site_hook: Would need an opening-size vs distance table (e.g. finger/hand reach through opening using hand anthropometry).

requirements.title: Telescoping ladder finger clearance
requirements.text: Finger clearance shall be provided between rungs of telescoping ladders (no value given).

values.quantity: finger clearance between telescoping ladder rungs

requirements.site_hook: Ladder object rung overlap gap vs finger thickness of P95/P99 hand.

requirements.title: Protrusions and sharp edges for carrying
requirements.text: Units shall employ protections so users can carry them without cutting hands on sharp edges (5.7.9.3.1); flat-head screws where possible, otherwise pan-head (5.7.9.3.2); exposed surfaces machined smooth, covered, or coated (5.7.9.3.3).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Avoid small projections in rapid-movement areas
requirements.text: In areas where users must make rapid movements, small projecting components should be avoided or covered; small projecting parts (toggle switches, small knobs) on a front panel should be recessed (5.7.9.3.5).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Exhaust openings away from personnel
requirements.text: Air-exhaust openings shall be located where personnel are not exposed to direct drafts.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Maximum perforation diameter
requirements.text: Housings, cabinets, and covers shall be perforated as necessary for air circulation; perforations shall be not larger than 13 mm (0.5 in) in diameter. Components that rotate, oscillate, or carry high voltage shall be spaced back from perforations so personnel cannot touch them accidentally (5.7.9.5.2).
requirements.site_hook: Opening-size parameter; finger-probe reach depth through opening from hand anthropometry.

requirements.title: Equipment not a tripping hazard
requirements.text: Equipment shall not pose a tripping hazard during operation and maintenance (portable stands, tables, benches, platforms, ladders often do).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Non-skid walkways and climbing surfaces
requirements.text: Walkways, catwalks, and any surfaces used for climbing shall have non-skid metallic materials, expanded metal flooring, or abrasive surfaces (see 5.7.7.2).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Ladders and steps de-iceable
requirements.text: Ladders and steps shall use materials that can be de-iced with hot water or steam.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Hand grips at platforms, walkways, stairs, floor openings
requirements.text: Platforms, walkways, stairs, and areas around floor openings shall have hand grips.
requirements.site_hook: Check that a handrail/grab handle object is attached to each platform, stairs and floor opening in the scene.

requirements.title: Hand grips fixed
requirements.text: Hand grips shall be fixed, unless this poses a hazard to users.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Fold-away hand grips
requirements.text: When required, hand grips shall fold or telescope so they are concealed or flush with the surface except when being used.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Folding grips stay folded
requirements.text: Folding grips shall remain securely folded when not in use.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: No tools to open folding grips
requirements.text: Users shall not require tools to open folding grips for use.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Center of gravity on inclines
requirements.text: Equipment should be designed to maximize safety and stability when moved on inclines, such as cargo ramps, or lifted by cranes for shipping (figure 54).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Mark center of gravity and jacking points
requirements.text: The center of gravity and jacking points shall each be marked on equipment to show their locations.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: CG marking for loads over 45.5 kg
requirements.text: Skids, uniquely shaped boxes or packages, or loads in excess of 45.5 kg (100 lb) shall have unobstructed markings of the center of gravity.
requirements.site_hook: Box/crate mass > 45.5 kg: require a 'CG marked' flag.

requirements.title: Mark lifting capability
requirements.text: Weight lifting or supporting capacity of stands, hoists, cranes, jacks, padeyes, rigging and other lifting/support equipment shall be marked per 5.4.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Target population defined in system specification
requirements.text: The target user population and percentage to be accommodated shall be as defined in the system specification.
requirements.site_hook: Project setting: population (country/role/sex) and accommodation %, defaulting to 4.5.3.

requirements.title: Full range of personnel with clothing and equipment
requirements.text: Systems, equipment and facilities used by operators, maintainers and supporters shall be designed for full use by the range of personnel with applicable operational clothing, protective clothing and specialized equipment.
requirements.site_hook: Needs a clothing/equipment allowance setting (NATICK/TR-14/019 increments) added to body dimensions.

requirements.title: Both genders
requirements.text: The population(s) to be accommodated shall include both genders of applicable military, non-military and foreign military personnel.
requirements.site_hook: Every check runs for female and male boundary manikins; a report is incomplete if only one sex is checked.

requirements.title: Special and sub-populations
requirements.text: Selected/specialized sub-populations (5.8.2.3), gender-specific (5.8.2.3.1), foreign military (5.8.2.3.2) and joint service (5.8.2.3.3) populations may be used in lieu of 5.8.4 if specified; mixed populations shall give each sub-population the specified accommodation (5.8.2.3.4).
requirements.site_hook: Population selector already supports ~60 countries/roles; mixed population = run the check for each selected population and report each.

requirements.title: Design limits: central 90 percent
requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, design shall accommodate the multivariate central 90 percent (95 percent preferred) of suitably clothed and equipped males and of females using dimensions applicable to the tasks.
requirements.site_hook: Same as 4.5.3.
requirements.percentile_rule: central 90% (95% preferred) per sex

requirements.title: Life-critical systems: central 99 percent
requirements.text: For life-critical systems and equipment (e.g. accessibility of safety interlocks, clearances for ejection seats, fit of gas masks) all physical factors (size, shape, weight, reach, strength, endurance) shall accommodate the multivariate central 99 percent of suitably clothed and equipped males and of females.
requirements.site_hook: A 'life-critical' flag per object/check switches the boundary to P0.5..P99.5 per sex (site percentile range 0.1-99.9 supports it).
requirements.percentile_rule: central 99% per sex

requirements.title: Use human figure modeling and 3-D scans
requirements.text: Designers shall use the appropriate anthropometric data and should use human figure modeling and 3-D body scans to obtain measurement, size, shape and volumetric data to meet 5.8.3.
requirements.site_hook: The Digital human tab is this capability; report should state data source and model version.

requirements.title: Use of anthropometric data: task factors
requirements.text: Application of anthropometric data shall consider (a) nature, frequency, safety and difficulty of tasks; (b) body positions during the tasks; (c) mobility, strength or flexibility requirements; (d) increments in design-critical dimensions to compensate for obstacles and projections.
requirements.site_hook: Per-check inputs: task posture (from the posture library), frequency, criticality.

requirements.title: Safety and health limits govern
requirements.text: Where safety and health design limits are more demanding than accommodation criteria, the safety and health considerations shall be satisfied.
requirements.site_hook: Report rule: when two limits apply, take the stricter.

requirements.title: Anthropometric databases
requirements.text: The appropriate anthropometric database(s) shall be used as specified: Army NATICK/TR-15/007 and NATICK/TR-16/013; Air Force AFRL-RH-WP-TR-2014-0113; Marine Corps NATICK/TR-13/018; DOD-HDBK-743 only where the service-specific sources are inadequate. The most current target-population data should be used.
requirements.site_hook: ANSUR II 2012 (NATICK/TR-15/007) individual records are already in data/ansur-ii-2012; TR-16/013 (Army aviators) and TR-13/018 (USMC 2010) are catalogued. Report should name the database used and warn when a non-listed source is chosen.

requirements.title: Clothing and equipment adjustments
requirements.text: Because the data are semi-nude measurements, design-critical dimensions shall be adjusted for all applicable clothing and equipment (uniforms, helmets, boots, body armor, load carriage, protective equipment, hydration packs). Factors are in NATICK/TR-14/019; if not available, designers shall derive them empirically.
requirements.site_hook: New input: clothing/equipment ensemble with per-dimension increments (from NATICK/TR-14/019) applied to the mannequin before clearance checks.

requirements.title: Clearance dimensions
requirements.text: Clearance dimensions (e.g. minimum dimensions for passageways and accesses) shall accommodate or allow passage of the body or parts of the body, including applicable clothing and equipment.
requirements.site_hook: Clearance checks use the LARGE boundary (P95/P99 male, clothed); body-envelope vs doorway/hatch/corridor openings.
requirements.percentile_rule: largest boundary case, clothed

requirements.title: Adjustable dimensions
requirements.text: Seats, restraint systems, safety harnesses, belts, controls or any equipment that must be adjusted for safety, comfort or performance shall be adjustable for the range of personnel using them, including clothing and equipment.
requirements.site_hook: For adjustable objects (seat height, monitor height, console): check that both small and large boundary manikins find a setting inside the object's adjustment range (e.g. seat height vs popliteal height P5F..P95M).
requirements.percentile_rule: adjustment range covers small to large boundary

requirements.title: Accounting for human variability
requirements.text: Percentiles are not additive and accommodating one dimension does not guarantee accommodation of others; when several dimensions must be accommodated at once designers shall use other appropriate methods (AFRL-HE-WP-TR-2007-0016): multivariate distributions, PCA, boundary cases on a multivariate envelope, 3-D digital human models of boundary cases, parametric accommodation models, morphometric shape analysis.
requirements.site_hook: Add boundary-manikin family (e.g. PCA ellipse on stature x mass or sitting height x buttock-knee from ANSUR II) and/or run checks over every ANSUR II individual and report % accommodated per sex.

requirements.title: Range of motion: do not exceed human limits
requirements.text: Design of systems shall not require operators, maintainers and supporters to exceed human range of motion limitations. Table XXXI gives limits (mean - 1 SD lower, mean + 1 SD upper) for semi-nude males (WADC-TR 55-159, WADC-TN-57-311), not reflecting clothing restrictions; other sources: NATICK/TR-17/010, NATICK/TR-13/033.
requirements.site_hook: Compare each posture's joint angles (metrics.js / rig ROM) to Table XXXI lower limit (mean - 1 SD) as the conservative capability; flag joints beyond it.

requirements.title: Trunk movement space
requirements.text: All operating positions shall allow enough space for the user to move their torso without interference through any potential action.
requirements.site_hook: Sweep torso through task motion and test collision with scene objects (needs body-object collision).

requirements.title: Whole-body movement space
requirements.text: When large forces (more than 13.6 kg [30 lb]) or large control displacements (more than 380 mm [15 in] fore-aft) are required, the user shall have enough space to move their entire body.

values.quantity: fore-aft control displacement triggering whole-body space

requirements.site_hook: Trigger when a control/lever/box has force > 13.6 kg or travel > 380 mm; then require free floor space around the mannequin.

requirements.title: Maintainer requirements apply to all personnel
requirements.text: When performing a maintenance-associated task (e.g., changing a flat tire, filling fluid levels), all requirements that apply to the maintainer shall also apply to all other personnel (operator, driver, crewmember, supporter).
requirements.site_hook: Scope note: apply maintenance checks below to any user role

requirements.title: Grasp areas/handles on removable components
requirements.text: Grasp areas or handles shall be incorporated where equipment/components are located such that full muscular strength cannot be applied (confined spaces, extended reach, awkward positioning) or where equipment or components are heavier than 25 lbs.

values.condition: handles required when heavier than 25 lb (no SI value printed; 25 lb = 11.3 kg)

requirements.title: Mechanical lifting assists
requirements.text: Where equipment or components without grasping or anchor points cannot be avoided, provision shall be made for mechanical lifting assists, and access for such support equipment shall be incorporated in the design.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item on box objects without handles

requirements.title: Removal by one person
requirements.text: Equipment shall be configured for removal and replacement by one person where permitted by structural, functional, and weight limitations (see 5.20.3).

values.condition: limits per 5.20.3 (lifting) - not in this range

requirements.site_hook: Box mass vs one-person lift limits of 5.20.3 with lift posture (lifting postures + box object)

requirements.title: Stowed items removable independently
requirements.text: Stowed items shall be capable of being removed and replaced without having to remove or replace other stowed items or components of the system.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Mission-critical items stowed for rapid access
requirements.text: Mission-critical maintenance items shall be stowed in a manner to permit rapid access by personnel.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist; could test reach from operator posture to stowage box

requirements.title: Retaining devices tool-free
requirements.text: Retaining devices shall be simple, capable of quick removal and replacement, and not require the use of tools; should be standardized across as many items as possible.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Maintenance in operational environment with PPE
requirements.text: Equipment shall be capable of being removed, replaced, repaired, assembled, and disassembled in its operational environment by personnel wearing any clothing and equipment appropriate to the environment and maintenance concept, including CBRNE or other mission-required PPE clothing.
requirements.site_hook: Needs clothing/PPE allowance on mannequin (glove, arctic, CBRNE) feeding the access-opening checks of Figure 57

requirements.title: Physical features preclude improper mounting
requirements.text: Equipment shall include physical features (supports, guides, size or shape differences, fastener locations, alignment pins) to preclude improper mounting.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Complete visual and physical access; favorable working level
requirements.text: Insofar as possible, equipment design and installation shall provide the maintainer with complete visual and physical access and a favorable working level for all parts on which maintenance is performed, including workstand interfaces, support equipment interfaces, access openings, adjustment points, test points, servicing points, and connections.
requirements.site_hook: Place maintenance-point targets; check line of sight from mannequin eye (unobstructed) and hand reach; working level via 5.9.3.14 (hip-shoulder band)

requirements.title: Connections readily accessible
requirements.text: Connections shall be arranged by equipment design or installation layout to provide the maintainer ready and functional access.
requirements.site_hook: Reach-to-target check on connector markers

requirements.title: Safety devices for maintenance on live systems
requirements.text: Emergency shutdown devices, lockable controls, electrical cutout switches, warning signs, or guards shall be used to ensure safety when maintenance is performed on or near a live or working system.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Work from ladders - one hand
requirements.text: Items to be maintained from a ladder shall require only one hand.

values.quantity: hands required for maintenance task from ladder

requirements.site_hook: Ladder object + ladder-climbing posture with one hand on rail; check other hand reaches item target; user flags task as one-handed

requirements.title: Maintenance of elevated structures
requirements.text: Maintenance on antennae, masts, lights, and other elevated structures shall be performed from a permanent or temporary work platform, vertical ladder with a hands-free climber safety rail, work basket supported by a crane, another stable standing surface, or by using anchor points, a safety lanyard, and a safety harness.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist; platform/ladder objects

requirements.title: Maintenance in place without removing other items
requirements.text: Maintenance on a unit or component should be able to be performed with it in place, where possible, and without disconnection, disassembly, or removal of other items.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Group components maintained by same individual
requirements.text: Components maintained by the same individual should be grouped together to minimize moving from position to position during system checking.
requirements.site_hook: Reach envelope from a single mannequin position covers all grouped targets

requirements.title: Frequent-access components easily viewed
requirements.text: Components requiring frequent access for visual inspection, check points, adjustment points, cable-end connectors, and labels shall be located in positions that can be easily viewed.
requirements.site_hook: Line of sight from mannequin eye to target markers, unobstructed; viewing angle check

requirements.title: Avoid stacking units
requirements.text: Whenever possible, units shall not be stacked; parts shall be mounted in an orderly array on a two-dimensional surface; if stacking is necessary the unit requiring least frequent access shall be in the back or on the bottom (5.9.2.2.1-5.9.2.2.2).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Hinge-mounted units open full distance and stay open
requirements.text: Small hinge-mounted units that require access to the back shall be free to open their full distance and shall be capable of remaining open without being held.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist; door/hatch object could expose open angle

requirements.title: Frames and structure do not interfere with access
requirements.text: Frames and structural members shall not interfere with personnel accessing components for maintenance, inspection, or operation.
requirements.site_hook: Collision/clearance check between mannequin arm path and sandbox objects when reaching to target

requirements.title: Minimal / common hand tools
requirements.text: Removal and replacement should require minimal tools and equipment and only common hand tools where practicable.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Straight-line removal path
requirements.text: Replaceable items, particularly disposable modules, should be removable without removal or disassembly of other items and along a straight or slightly curved line rather than through an angled course.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Heavy/large/awkward units slide out
requirements.text: Heavy, large, or awkward units should be located so they may be slid out or pulled out rather than lifted out, do not prevent access to other removable items, and are mounted on sliding drawers and racks wherever practicable.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Structural members do not block removable items
requirements.text: Structural members of items, chassis, or enclosures shall not prevent access to removable items, their connectors, or fasteners.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: One person preferred for removal
requirements.text: Removal and replacement should be accomplished by one person, two persons, or handling equipment, in that order of preference.
requirements.site_hook: Combine with box mass limits (5.9.3.11)

requirements.title: Guide pins for alignment
requirements.text: Items that must be precisely located or incorporate rack and panel connectors shall have guide pins, or their equivalent, to assist in alignment during mounting.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Bottom-mounted aligning pins for light components
requirements.text: Bottom-mounted aligning pins should be used for components weighing less than 9 kg (20 lb).

values.quantity: component mass for bottom-mounted aligning pins

requirements.site_hook: Box object mass < 9 kg -> recommend bottom aligning pins

requirements.title: Side-aligning devices for heavier components
requirements.text: Side-aligning devices or brackets should be used for heavier components (over 9 kg [20 lb]) so the components can be slid rather than lifted into and out of place.
requirements.site_hook: Box object mass > 9 kg -> flag need for slide/side-aligning mounting

requirements.title: Rollout racks, slides, or hinges
requirements.text: Items that are pulled out of their installed positions shall be mounted on rollout racks, slides, or hinges.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Rollout rack stability
requirements.text: Rollout racks pulled to the fully extended position shall not shift the center of gravity to the point where the rack or console becomes unstable.
requirements.site_hook: Would need rack object with mass distribution and extension; tip-over check

requirements.title: Pull-out rack/drawer operating force
requirements.text: Pull-out or slide-out racks and drawers shall be designed such that they operate with a force less than 17.8 newtons (4 pounds-force).
requirements.site_hook: Needs drawer/rack object with user-entered pull force

requirements.title: Pull-out rack design features
requirements.text: Pull-out/slide-out racks and drawers shall automatically lock in both servicing and operating positions; handles provided as necessary; assemblies may be opened without breaking internal connections needed for maintenance; guards and shields provided as necessary to protect fragile parts when moved.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Limit stops on racks and drawers
requirements.text: Limit stops shall be provided on racks and drawers required to be pulled out; stop design shall permit convenient overriding for removal (5.9.3.7.1); rollout racks and drawers shall be self-locking in retracted and extended positions (5.9.3.7.2).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Hinged items braced in out position
requirements.text: Hinged items shall be provided with a brace or other means of support to hold the item in the 'out' position for maintenance if it is not free to rotate and remain in the 'out' position without support.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Minimize place-to-place movement during checkout
requirements.text: Units shall be laid out so that a minimum of place-to-place movements will be required during checkout.
requirements.site_hook: Count of mannequin positions needed to reach all checkout targets

requirements.title: One-person removable component mass
requirements.text: Removable components to be handled by one person should weigh less than 13.6 kg, with 30 lb preferred, and shall weigh less than 20.5 kg (45 lb) maximum.

values.condition: should; printed as 'less than 13.6 kg, with 30 lb preferred'

requirements.site_hook: Sandbox box mass: warn > 13.6 kg, fail >= 20.5 kg for one-person handling

requirements.title: Heavy components easiest to reach, slide out
requirements.text: Whenever possible, heavier components shall be placed so they are the easiest to reach and can be slid out rather than lifted out.
requirements.site_hook: Rank boxes by mass vs reach distance from mannequin; heaviest should be closest / at favorable height

requirements.title: Difficult-to-reach item mass
requirements.text: Difficult-to-reach items shall weigh less than 11.3 kg (25 lb).
requirements.site_hook: Box mass vs reach: if hand reach to box requires near-full arm extension or awkward posture (e.g. outside hip-shoulder band, high RULA), mass must be < 11.3 kg

requirements.title: Two-person handling threshold
requirements.text: Items weighing over 20.5 kg (45 lb) shall be located for two-person handling.

requirements.title: Hoist lugs threshold
requirements.text: Hoist lugs should be provided for assemblies over 40.8 kg (90 lb).

requirements.title: Minimize covers to remove
requirements.text: The number of covers and panels that must be opened or removed to access a replaceable item shall be minimized.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Space for test probes
requirements.text: Space should be provided for use of test probes and other service or test equipment.
requirements.site_hook: See Figure 56 test-probe opening 90 x 90 mm

requirements.title: Favorable working level hip to shoulder
requirements.text: Components to be serviced or repaired should be located at the most favorable working level, generally between hip and shoulder level.

requirements.title: Rests and stands for maintenance
requirements.text: When required for maintenance, rests or stands shall be provided for holding units, test equipment, tools, and technical manuals; when permitted they shall be part of the basic unit, rack, or console chassis.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Extensions do not interfere with handling
requirements.text: Extensions and connected appurtenances (cables, hoses, etc.) shall not interfere with removing, replacing, or carrying an item; if they do, they shall be easily removed/disconnected before handling; disconnects shall be hand-operable quick disconnects or standard hand-tool disconnects, in that order (5.9.4.2.1-5.9.4.2.2).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Maintenance controls meet control and labeling requirements
requirements.text: Controls required for maintenance shall comply with the basic control design requirements (5.1) and labeling requirements (5.4).
requirements.site_hook: Cross-reference to control checks of 5.1/5.4

requirements.title: Knobs rather than screwdriver controls
requirements.text: Knobs, rather than screwdriver controls, shall be used whenever adjustments must be performed more often than once per month and where access, weight, and related considerations permit.

requirements.title: Blind screwdriver adjustments need guides

requirements.title: Reference scales visible
requirements.text: A scale or other reference shall be provided for all adjustment controls (5.9.5.5) and shall be readily visible to the person making the adjustment.

requirements.title: No mirrors or flashlights

requirements.title: Adjustment control mechanical stop strength
requirements.text: Calibration or adjustment controls intended to have a limited degree of motion shall have mechanical stops strong enough to prevent damage by a force or torque 100 times greater than the resistance to movement within the range of adjustment.

requirements.title: Hand or arm support under vibration

requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Adjustment controls away from hazards
requirements.text: Adjustment controls shall not be located within 300 mm (12 in) of unprotected dangerous voltages, moving machinery, or any other hazards; if unavoidable they shall be shielded and labeled (5.9.5.13).

requirements.text: Structural members or permanently installed equipment shall not visually or physically obstruct any required maintenance tasks; panels/cases/covers to be removed have same access requirements as the equipment (5.9.6.1.1); mounting provisions shall be directly visible and physically accessible (5.9.6.1.2).

requirements.title: Large items do not block access

requirements.title: Test points etc. accessible and visible; space for tools
requirements.text: Check points, adjustment points, test points, cables, connectors, and labels shall be accessible and visible during maintenance (5.9.6.3.1); sufficient space shall be provided for use of test equipment and tools without difficulty or hazard (5.9.6.3.2).
requirements.site_hook: Reach + line of sight to targets; tool-space via Figure 56 opening sizes

requirements.title: Rear access equipment opens fully and stays open

requirements.title: Relative accessibility
requirements.text: Mission-critical items needing rapid maintenance shall be the most accessible; when criticality is not a factor, items requiring most frequent access shall be the most accessible; high failure rate items shall be replaceable without moving non-failed items.

requirements.title: Features to assist maintenance personnel

requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Non-skid surfaces on equipment used as platforms

requirements.title: Physical space accommodates maintainer population
requirements.text: Physical space shall be designed into and within the system and equipment so that accessibility for all required maintenance activities is provided for the multivariate central 90 percent (95 percent preferred) of suitably clothed and equipped males of the maintainer population and the multivariate central 90 percent (95 percent preferred) of suitably clothed and equipped females, using dimensions applicable to the task.

requirements.title: Access for maintenance body postures per 5.10
requirements.text: Where maintenance tasks require various body postures, the access opening and physical space requirements for these postures shall be provided in accordance with 5.10.
requirements.site_hook: Use kneeling/squatting/prone/supine/crawling posture envelopes from 5.10 (other group) against sandbox clearances

requirements.title: Maintenance from above and outside
requirements.text: Whenever possible, equipment design shall permit maintenance from above and outside rather than from underneath or inside components.

requirements.title: Minimum floor space per maintainer
requirements.text: Floor space of 0.4 square meters (m2) (4.0 square feet [ft2]) minimum per person shall be provided for maintenance personnel and their clothing (including required PPE, tools, and equipment) as well as free space for the movements and activities required to perform maintenance tasks.

values.condition: minimum per person, plus free space for movements

requirements.site_hook: Sandbox floor-area tool: free standing area around mannequin footprint >= 0.4 m2 per person

requirements.title: Order of preference for arm/hand access type
requirements.text: Where arm and hand access is required: (a) opening with no cover unless it degrades performance, safety, CBRNE/PPE survivability; (b) hand-operated (latched, sliding, hinged) cap or door where dirt/moisture is a problem; (c) quick-opening cover plate using 1/4-turn captive fasteners if a cap will not meet stress requirements or space prevents a hinged cover; (d) screw-down cover when captive fasteners cannot be used.
requirements.site_hook: Hatch object 'cover type' attribute; checklist

requirements.title: Whole-body access openings
requirements.text: Where whole-body access is required, the opening shall accommodate the multivariate central 90 percent (95 percent preferred) of suitably clothed and equipped males and of females of the maintainer population using dimensions applicable to the task.
requirements.site_hook: Hatch/door object width & height vs mannequin body envelope (shoulder/bideltoid breadth, chest/abdominal depth, stature or crouched height) + clothing/equipment allowance, at boundary percentiles; pass mannequin through in walking/crawling posture and check collisions
requirements.percentile_rule: multivariate central 90% (95% preferred) of suitably clothed and equipped males and of females of the maintainer population

requirements.title: Rescue access openings
requirements.text: Where rescue of personnel may be required because of environmental hazards (e.g., toxic fumes inside fuel tanks), access openings for rescue personnel shall be provided.
requirements.site_hook: Hatch must pass rescuer plus casualty; checklist / two-mannequin clearance

requirements.title: Interlocked barrier over hazards
requirements.text: If a hazardous condition (e.g., exposed high voltage conductors) exists behind the access, a physical barrier over the access shall be equipped with an interlock that de-energizes the hazard when the barrier is open or removed; hazard and interlock existence noted on case/cover visible when open (5.9.6.13).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Access provided for frequent maintenance
requirements.text: An access shall be provided if frequent maintenance would otherwise require removing a case or covering, opening a fitting, or dismantling an item.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Fewest simple fasteners on covers
requirements.text: Hinged or removable covers shall be fastened with the fewest practical number of simple-to-use fasteners.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Self-supporting hinged covers; one-hand operation
requirements.text: Hinged access covers that are not completely removable shall be self-supporting in the open position; open cover shall not obstruct visual or physical access (5.9.7.3.1); self-supporting covers shall be opened and closed with one hand (5.9.7.3.2).
requirements.site_hook: Hatch object with open-angle; check open leaf does not intersect line of sight/arm path

requirements.title: Access labeling
requirements.text: Each access shall be labeled with nomenclature for items visible/accessible through it, auxiliary equipment, and recommended procedures; with hazard warning signs (5.9.7.4.1); opening a cover shall not remove or obscure hazard warnings (5.9.7.4.2); instructions on hinged doors oriented to be read when open (5.9.7.4.3).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Warning letter height 25% larger
requirements.text: Warning notices shall be clear, direct, attention-getting, and have a 25-percent larger letter height than any detailed instructions that follow.

values.quantity: warning letter height / instruction letter height

requirements.site_hook: User enters label letter heights

requirements.title: Visual angle through access
requirements.text: Where visual access is required, the opening shall provide a visual angle large enough to allow maintenance personnel to view all required information from their normal maintenance position.
requirements.site_hook: Ray-cast from mannequin eye in maintenance posture through hatch opening to all target points

requirements.title: Unrestricted visual access without bending
requirements.text: Maintenance personnel shall be provided unrestricted visual access from the workstation without bending.
requirements.site_hook: Line of sight from mannequin eye in upright standing/seated posture (trunk flexion ~0) to targets must be unobstructed

requirements.title: Visual-only access order of precedence
requirements.text: Where visual access only is required: (a) opening with no cover; (b) transparent window if dirt/moisture problem; (c) break-resistant glass if wear, heat or solvents; (d) quick-opening opaque cover if glass will not meet requirements.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Covers removable without taking equipment apart
requirements.text: Covers, cases, and shields shall be removable/replaceable if damaged (5.9.8.1); holes large enough for screw clearance without perfect alignment (5.9.8.2); capable of being opened or removed without taking the equipment apart or removing auxiliary equipment (5.9.8.3).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Open covers do not obscure controls
requirements.text: When open, covers, cases, and shields shall not obscure or interfere with controls, displays, test points, or connections used in working inside the access or enclosure.
requirements.site_hook: Open hatch leaf vs line of sight and reach path

requirements.title: Stops, retainers and hold-open devices
requirements.text: Covers, cases, and shields shall have stops and retainers to keep them from swinging against or being dropped on fragile equipment or personnel (5.9.8.5) and locking devices or retaining bars to hold them open if they might otherwise fall shut (5.9.8.6).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Cover and case labels
requirements.text: Labels/markings on covers and cases shall: present opening/removal instructions unless obvious; indicate functions behind the enclosure; present procedures visible and oriented when open; warn of hazards; indicate orientation of units through the opening.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Cases self-supporting when open
requirements.text: Cases shall not require manual support to remain in the open position during maintenance.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Case size margin
requirements.text: Cases shall be sufficiently larger than the items they cover to facilitate installation and removal with little or no case manipulation; guides, tracks and stops provided as necessary (5.9.9.5).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist (no numeric margin given)

requirements.title: Cover type order of preference
requirements.text: Covers should be used in order: (a) hinged doors, hoods, caps (double-hinged split doors where swing space limited; hinges at bottom or prop/catch to hold open, especially in high winds); (b) sliding doors and caps (lock positively, no jamming, no tools); (c) removable doors, plates, caps (tongue-and-slot catches, retainer chains, cannot attach improperly); (d) removable panels or sections (minimum combination-head captive fasteners, spring-loaded quarter-turn fasteners; designed so one person can carry them; removable with common hand tools; handles; hinged if wires attached).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist; one-person carry of panel can use box mass limits

requirements.title: Obvious when cover not in place
requirements.text: It shall be obvious when a cover is not in place or is not securely fastened; non-obvious opening methods shall have permanent instructions on the outside (5.9.10.3) using simple symbols or words like 'push' (5.9.10.3.1).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Ventilation hole size
requirements.text: If a cover or shield requires ventilation holes, the holes shall be not larger than 13 mm (0.5 in) in diameter.
requirements.site_hook: Cover object vent-hole diameter parameter; compare also with mannequin finger breadth (finger-probe concept)

requirements.title: Hazards spaced back from ventilation holes
requirements.text: Any component that rotates, oscillates, or carries high voltage shall be spaced back from ventilation holes so personnel cannot accidentally contact the hazard.
requirements.site_hook: Finger length (mannequin hand) vs set-back distance behind vent holes; no number given

requirements.title: Grasp areas on access covers
requirements.text: Access covers shall be equipped with grasp areas or other means for opening them; non-removable covers should be retainable open (5.9.10.8.1).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Covers accommodate handwear
requirements.text: Covers shall accommodate handwear or other special clothing that may be worn by maintenance personnel.
requirements.site_hook: Grasp-area/finger recess sizes vs gloved hand dimensions (use Figure 57 gloved values)

requirements.title: Adjacent hinged doors open opposite
requirements.text: When hinged doors are adjacent, they shall open in opposite directions to maximize accessibility.
requirements.site_hook: Door objects hinge-side parameter

requirements.title: Sweep volume for hinged covers
requirements.text: If covers are hinged, space equal to the sweep volume of the cover should be allowed so the body frame and brackets will not obstruct its opening.
requirements.site_hook: Door/hatch swing arc collision check with other sandbox objects

requirements.title: Door stops/retainers
requirements.text: Stops or retainers shall be used as necessary to keep doors from swinging into adjacent controls or fragile components and so they will not spring their hinges.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Rounded edges on doors and covers
requirements.text: Sharp edges and corners on doors, covers, and other exposed surfaces that might present a safety hazard shall be rounded in accordance with 5.7.6.4.
requirements.site_hook: Object edge-radius parameter vs 5.7.6.4

requirements.title: Minimize fastener number and diversity
requirements.text: Number and diversity of fasteners shall be minimized; locations of differing fasteners distinguishable (5.9.11.1.1); identical fasteners not used where wrong removal causes damage (5.9.11.1.2); finger/hand-operated fasteners preferred (5.9.11.1.3); fasteners shall not require non-standard tools (5.9.11.1.4).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Captive fasteners
requirements.text: Captive fasteners shall be used where dropping or losing them could cause damage or hazardous removal problems, and for access covers requiring frequent removal (5.9.11.4).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Latches and catches
requirements.text: Latches and catches shall give clear visual indication of engagement; spring/snap-down force shall not be so strong it could injure personnel (5.9.11.5.1); located to avoid inadvertent operation (5.9.11.5.2).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: High-torque fasteners external hex; direct tool access
requirements.text: External hex or external double-hex wrenching elements should be provided on all fasteners requiring more than 14 newton-meters (10 foot-pounds-force) of torque; direct tool access shall be provided to allow torquing without swivel or universal joint extensions.

values.quantity: fastener torque threshold for external hex

requirements.site_hook: User-entered fastener torque; direct straight tool path check (tool clearance)

requirements.title: Low-torque fastener head types
requirements.text: External hex, internal hex, combination head, or star fasteners shall be provided where less than 14 newton-meters (10 foot-pounds-force) torque is required; straight-slot or cross-recess internal grip fasteners should not be used except wood fasteners or standard commercial items.
requirements.site_hook: User-entered fastener type/torque

requirements.title: One-hand/one-tool nuts and bolts
requirements.text: Nuts and bolts removed frequently and relatively inaccessible shall be removable/replaceable with one hand or one tool; nut or bolt semi-permanently attached (5.9.11.6.12).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Hand or tool clearance at nuts and bolts
requirements.text: Nuts and bolts shall have hand or tool clearance for easy operation.
requirements.site_hook: Use Figure 56 tool envelopes (e.g. open-end wrench 270 x 200 mm, 60 deg swing) around fastener

requirements.title: Lubrication points accessible
requirements.text: Lubrication and reservoir checking shall be possible without disassembly (5.9.12.2); lubrication points shall be accessible, clearly labeled, with captive caps where applicable (5.9.12.5); extended fittings for ports not readily accessible or visible (5.9.12.6).
requirements.site_hook: Reach + line-of-sight check to lube-point markers

requirements.title: Cable coding interval
requirements.text: Cables containing individually insulated conductors with a common sheath shall be coded every 300 mm (12 in).
requirements.site_hook: Not a body-dimension check; checklist

requirements.title: Cable clamp spacing
requirements.text: Clamps or plates that mount lines and cables shall have heat-insulating liners and be spaced not more than 610 mm (24 in) apart or as specified.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Cables not used as handholds or steps
requirements.text: Interconnecting cables shall be routed to minimize use as handholds or steps; a protective guard shall be placed over lines/cables where such use is possible (5.9.13.4.2); routing shall not obstruct visual or physical access (5.9.13.4).
requirements.site_hook: Flag cable objects within mannequin hand/foot reach along climbing paths (ladder/step postures)

requirements.title: Lines and cables accessible
requirements.text: Lines and cables shall be accessible without disassembling other equipment (5.9.13.5.1), with accesses and clearances for removal/replacement (5.9.13.5.3), and routed to be accessible for inspection (5.9.13.7).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Wire number code interval
requirements.text: Number codes shall be repeated every 500 mm (20 in) over the entire length of the wire.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Fluid connectors - no jacking
requirements.text: Connectors for pipes, tubing, and hoses shall be located so that it is unnecessary to jack the equipment up to drain, fill, or perform other maintenance.
requirements.site_hook: Reach check from standing/kneeling mannequin to drain/fill point without supine posture

requirements.title: Quick-disconnect plugs (one turn)
requirements.text: Plugs requiring not more than one turn or other quick-disconnect plugs shall be provided whenever feasible; connectors shall plug in or secure with not more than one complete turn (5.9.14.13.2).

values.condition: not more than one complete turn

requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Connector labels visible
requirements.text: Labels or codes on connectors shall be visible during maintenance whether connected or disconnected; connectors identifiable without disconnecting (5.9.14.4.2).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Connector spacing for grasp
requirements.text: Connectors shall be spaced far enough apart that they can be grasped firmly; spacing between adjacent connectors or a connector and an obstruction shall be compatible with plug size/shape and clothing worn (cold weather handwear, CBRNE gloves, PPE) (5.9.14.7.1).
requirements.site_hook: Connector marker objects with spacing; handwear selector

requirements.title: Connector spacing - bare fingers
requirements.text: For bare finger operation, spacing between adjacent connectors shall be not less than 25 mm (1 in), except where connectors are sequentially removed and replaced and 25 mm (1 in) clearance is provided in a swept area of not less than 270 degrees around each connector at the start of its removal and replacement sequence.
requirements.site_hook: Connector objects; edge-to-edge gap measured from outermost portion (5.9.14.7.4)

requirements.title: Connector spacing - gloved/grip/mittened
requirements.text: Spacing between adjacent connectors shall be not less than 32 mm (1.25 in) if operated with gloved fingers, 64 mm (2.5 in) if the connector must be gripped firmly, and 75 mm (3 in) if operated with mittened hands; may be reduced where connectors are sequentially removed and full clearance is provided in a swept area of not less than 270 degrees around each connector.
requirements.site_hook: Connector objects + handwear selector

requirements.title: Connector spacing measurement
requirements.text: Spacing shall be measured from the outermost portion of the connector (backshell, strain relief clamp, dust cover, or EMI/RFI shield).
requirements.site_hook: Defines measurement method for 5.9.14.7.2-3

requirements.title: Space for connector wrench
requirements.text: Where high torque is required to tighten or loosen the connector, space shall be provided for use of a connector wrench.
requirements.site_hook: Tool clearance envelope around connector

requirements.title: Rear of plug connectors accessible
requirements.text: The rear of plug connectors shall be accessible for testing and servicing, except where precluded by potting, sealing, or other requirements.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Fuses readily accessible
requirements.text: Fuses shall be readily accessible for removal and replacement; no other components shall require removal to access fuses (5.9.16.2.2.1); no special tools unless required by safety (5.9.16.2.2.2).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Circuit breakers within reach in operating posture
requirements.text: When resetting of circuit breakers is permissible and required for system operation during a mission, the breakers shall be located within reach of maintenance personnel in their normal operating posture.
requirements.site_hook: Reach-to-target from mannequin in operating posture (e.g. seated/vehicle) to breaker panel target; P5 female reach governs
requirements.percentile_rule: smallest user (e.g. P5 female) functional reach

requirements.title: Circuit breaker dimensions and separation
requirements.text: Dimensions and separation for toggle bat actuated circuit breakers shall be in accordance with figure 16; for legend switch actuated circuit breakers in accordance with figure 17.

values.condition: values in Figures 16 and 17 (controls section 5.1, outside this range; not re-read here)

requirements.site_hook: Cross-reference to toggle switch / legend switch checks of 5.1

requirements.title: Test and service point design/location criteria
requirements.text: Test and service points should be located by frequency of use; distinguishable; with positive indication of adjustment; at central panel(s); with leads/extended fittings to bring hard-to-reach points to an accessible area; not isolated; not concealed by braces, brackets or structure.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Test points close to adjustment controls/displays
requirements.text: Test points used for adjustment shall be located sufficiently close to the controls and displays used in the adjustment so that place-to-place movement is not required; they shall be physically and visually accessible in the installed condition without removing other items (5.9.17.2.2).
requirements.site_hook: From one mannequin position: hand reach to test point and control, and eye line-of-sight to display, all satisfied simultaneously

requirements.title: Test points face maintainer
requirements.text: Test points and their labels and controls shall face the maintenance personnel; located on surfaces or behind accesses easily reached when fully assembled and installed (5.9.17.5).
requirements.site_hook: Target surface normal vs eye direction; reach check

requirements.title: Test point minimum clearance
requirements.text: Test points shall be located so that a minimum clearance of 19 mm (0.75 in) is provided when only finger control is required and 75 mm (3.0 in) is provided when a gloved hand must be used.
requirements.site_hook: Test-point marker clearance to nearest object; handwear selector

requirements.title: Test point guards and shields
requirements.text: Test points shall have guards and shields to protect personnel and equipment, particularly if serviced while operating; isolated positions avoided (5.9.17.8); windows for frequent visual inspection (5.9.17.9); tool guides for blind operation (5.9.17.10).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist

requirements.title: Test points within functional reach of related controls
requirements.text: Test points shall be located within easy functional reach or seeing distance of related or corresponding controls, displays, fittings, and switches.
requirements.site_hook: Distance test point <-> related control within mannequin functional reach envelope; eye-to-display distance

requirements.title: Test points away from hazards
requirements.text: Test points shall be located at least 115 mm (4.5 in) away from electrical, mechanical, or other hazards.

values.quantity: distance from test point to hazard

requirements.site_hook: Point-to-point distance test-point marker to hazard marker

requirements.title: Test equipment instructions readable during operation
requirements.text: Instructions for operating portable test equipment shall be directly readable while the equipment is operated; printed large enough to be seen in the lowest light level likely (5.9.18.2.2).

requirements.title: Harness or sling for portable test equipment

requirements.title: Population accommodation for workspace design
requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, design of DoD systems, equipment and facilities shall accommodate the multivariate central 90 percent (95 percent preferred) of suitably clothed and equipped males and the multivariate central 90 percent (95 percent preferred) of suitably clothed and equipped females of the target user population (see 5.8), using dimensions applicable to the task. For univariate accommodation, the central 95 percent of the male and the central 95 percent of the female target user population should be used.

requirements.title: Minimum area to accomplish a task
requirements.text: The required width and depth allowance to accomplish a task within the space shall be 76.2 cm (30 in) width and 115.6 cm (45.5 in) depth for a given posture.

requirements.title: Display type
requirements.text: The type of display selected shall comply with 5.2.2.8.
requirements.site_hook: Cross-reference to 5.2.2.8

requirements.title: Personnel considerations
requirements.text: In establishing the workspace, consideration shall be given to user body postures required, whether the work is fixed, mobile or temporary, the environment, and the number of personnel required.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Postures considered
requirements.text: Workspace design shall consider the body postures to include standing, sitting, squatting, and kneeling, among other relevant postures.
requirements.site_hook: Run the workspace with standing, sitting, squatting and kneeling postures from the posture library

requirements.title: Neutral posture
requirements.text: To the maximum extent possible, a workspace shall allow personnel to maintain a neutral posture.
requirements.site_hook: Joint angles vs neutral ranges; RULA/REBA low-risk score (e.g. RULA 1-2)
requirements.percentile_rule: multivariate central 90% (95% preferred) of clothed/equipped males and of females; univariate: central 95% of each sex (i.e. P2.5 female to P97.5 male)

requirements.title: Changing posture
requirements.text: To the maximum extent possible, a workspace shall be designed to allow personnel to change their posture (e.g. between standing and sitting) while maintaining the ability to remain neutral.
requirements.site_hook: Evaluate the same workstation in both sitting and standing postures; both should give low RULA

requirements.title: Forward reach: lifting and torque in neutral posture
requirements.text: Jobs requiring the user to lift an object or produce torque (e.g., turning a wrench) shall maintain a neutral posture.
requirements.site_hook: Lifting/torque postures: REBA/RULA and trunk flexion/arm reach checks

requirements.title: Kick space
requirements.text: All cabinets, workstations, consoles, and work surfaces shall contain a kick space at the base at least 10 cm (4 in) deep and 10 cm (4 in) high to allow for standard footwear. Some oversized boots, such as the Arctic cold-weather boot, may require a larger kick space.
requirements.site_hook: New Sandbox console/cabinet parameter: toe recess height and depth

requirements.title: Boot dimensions for kick space
requirements.text: Kick space dimensions shall be adjusted to accommodate DoD footwear. Unless otherwise specified, footwear (boots including outer sole) shall accommodate the largest allowable values (e.g., Air Force men's 17 EEEE or women's 11 EE, Army 14 regular): a. Boot length 40 cm (16 in); b. Boot height 29.2 cm (11.5 in); c. Toe height 11.4 cm (4.5 in); d. Boot width 15.2 cm (6 in).
requirements.site_hook: Add a boot envelope (40 x 15.2 x 29.2 cm, toe 11.4 cm) to the mannequin feet; test kick space, footrest and pedal clearances with it
requirements.percentile_rule: Largest allowable boot (AF men's 17 EEEE / women's 11 EE / Army 14 regular)

requirements.title: Boots combined with PPE
requirements.text: Boots measuring outside of the above dimensions, such as when combined with PPE, shall be as specified (see 6.2).
requirements.site_hook: User-entered boot size override

requirements.title: Standing workspaces per figure 59
requirements.text: Dimensions for standing workspaces shall be designed as shown on figure 59. For arctic or encumbered soldier conditions, work clearances should be reviewed against figure 60 (see 5.8.4.2.3).
requirements.site_hook: Apply Figure 59 checks (and Figure 60 arctic column when clothing = arctic)

requirements.title: Sitting workspaces per figure 58; seat for extended tasks
requirements.text: Sitting workspaces shall be in accordance with figure 58. In general, if space allows, the user should be provided a seat for extended tasks (longer than 20 minutes).

requirements.title: Minimum workspace height, seated operations
requirements.text: The minimum workspace height required to perform work at a task site shall be 150 cm (59 in) for seated operations.

requirements.title: Adjustable seat
requirements.text: The seat design shall provide for adjustability.

Lower drawing: preferred control area between SHOULDER LEVEL and WAIST LEVEL, depth labelled 610 MM, for the 5TH PERCENTILE user.

requirements.text: The lateral distance behind seated workstations is passing clearance as measured from the edge of the work surface (see figure 77).

requirements.title: Workspace environment considerations
requirements.text: Consideration shall be given to the environments in which work will be performed (indoors/outdoors, offices, ships, tents, etc.); temperature regulation should not be assumed.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Free floor space in front of workstation/console
requirements.text: Free floor space of not less than 122 cm (48 in) for the breadth of the workstation or console shall be provided in front of each workstation or console.

values.condition: [48 in]; over full breadth of the console

requirements.title: Hazards within reach envelope
requirements.text: If a hazard (e.g., hot surface, electrical contact) exists within the user's reach envelopes, it shall be guarded, removed, or moved beyond the maximum reach of the user.
requirements.site_hook: Tag Sandbox object as hazard; check it lies outside the P95 male maximum reach envelope or is marked guarded
requirements.percentile_rule: Use largest (P95/P97.5 male) maximum reach

requirements.title: Flushing, draining and venting discharge
requirements.text: Flushing, draining, and venting facilities shall discharge so that pipe contents do not go onto walking surfaces or into workspaces where personnel could be hit.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Valves per 5.14
requirements.text: Valves shall be installed in accordance with 5.14.
requirements.site_hook: Cross-reference to 5.14

requirements.title: Workbench separation from hazards
requirements.text: Unless the hazard is guarded, workbenches shall not be located within 1 m (3.2 ft) of rotating shafts, hot or cold piping, or any other hazard that a crewmember could contact due to unexpected motion.

values.quantity: distance from workbench to unguarded hazard

requirements.site_hook: Tag hazard objects; measure distance from workbench edge

requirements.title: Eliminate interference among crewmembers
requirements.text: The workspace shall be designed to eliminate interference among crewmembers during operation or maintenance.
requirements.site_hook: Place several mannequins; check body/reach-envelope overlaps

requirements.title: Avoid simultaneous tasks
requirements.text: Multiple simultaneous tasks shall be avoided unless the workspace is specifically designed to allow them without interference.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist item

requirements.title: Guards
requirements.text: Guards shall be provided to minimize exposing the user to dangerous conditions (rotating equipment, hot or cold points, exposed wiring, crushing points). 5.10.2.9.9.1: it shall not be possible to remove guards during operation. 5.10.2.9.9.2: tools shall be required for removal of guards during maintainer tasks. 5.10.2.9.9.3: guards shall be accessible from at least two sides.

values.quantity: number of sides from which guard is accessible

requirements.text: Workstation configurations are standing, sitting, and sit-stand. requirements.title: Physical environment design

requirements.title: Traffic areas
requirements.text: Traffic area and flow design should consider task activities around workstations, minimal interference between workstations and traffic, equipment movements, normal/worst/emergency traffic, and collision avoidance.

requirements.title: Layout to minimize congestion

requirements.title: Equipment arrangement for multiple workers

requirements.title: Layout for safety, criticality and frequency
requirements.text: All equipment shall be located to minimize equipment damage, personnel injury, or inadvertent actuation; the most critical units shall be the most accessible; where criticality is not a factor, units with more total use shall be more accessible.

requirements.text: The platform shall hold the worker(s) plus the heaviest tools and equipment expected plus a safety factor; use 113.4 kg (250 lb) per person to estimate personnel weight.
requirements.site_hook: Platform load rating entered by user vs persons x 113.4 kg + tool masses.

requirements.title: Test equipment support height on platform
requirements.text: When test equipment will be used, the design shall provide support for test equipment at the appropriate height for its use.
requirements.site_hook: Shelf/table object height vs mannequin elbow/eye height on platform.

requirements.title: Platform surfaces: grating / non-skid
requirements.text: Exterior platforms and similar work areas shall be constructed of open metal grating; where grating is impractical, and for interior platforms and passageways, floor surfaces shall be treated with non-skid material (5.11.6.1.9).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Portable platforms
requirements.text: Portable platforms should be lightweight and fully collapsible; any platform on wheels shall have brakes and wheel locks (5.11.6.2.2).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Guardrails with two rails on open sides
requirements.text: All open sides of personnel platforms shall be equipped with guardrails that have at least two rails (an intermediate rail and top rail).

values.quantity: number of rails on open sides

requirements.site_hook: Platform object with rail count per side.

requirements.title: Guardrail top rail height
requirements.text: Top rail height shall be not less than 1.1 m (42 in).
requirements.site_hook: Rail object height above platform surface; compare with mannequin COM height.

requirements.title: Guardrail setback from platform edge
requirements.text: Distance between the platform edge and the centerline of the railing shall be not greater than 65 mm (2.5 in).

values.quantity: platform edge to rail centerline distance

requirements.site_hook: Distance between rail object and platform edge.

requirements.title: Guardrail rail diameter
requirements.text: Rail diameter is between 37 mm (1.5 in) and 75 mm (3 in).
requirements.site_hook: Rail/grab-bar diameter parameter.

requirements.title: Toe board / guard screen height
requirements.text: The height of a toe board or guard screen shall be not less than 150 mm (6 in).

values.quantity: toe board or guard screen height

requirements.site_hook: Add toe-board parameter to platform object.

requirements.title: Platform handholds
requirements.text: Handholds shall be furnished where needed to assist in climbing onto a platform or as aids in performing maintenance tasks; and shall be provided (with guardrails) where personnel must stabilize themselves due to wind, ice, fog, other hazards or moving vehicles (5.11.6.3.5).
requirements.site_hook: Grab-bar placement within reach of climbing/standing mannequin.

requirements.title: Elevator/lift operating safety features
requirements.text: Where elevators, inclinators, or hydraulic work platforms are needed: maximum load signs easily seen; guards against accidental operation; easily reachable manual lowering capability when feasible; floor surface treatment per 5.11.6.1.9. Also limit stops and automatic fail-safe brake or self-locking device (5.11.6.4.2).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist; manual-lowering control reach could be checked with hand-reach tool.

requirements.title: Means of exit continuity
requirements.text: The exit path shall not be interrupted by any building element other than an exit component (e.g., a ramp).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Conventional entrances for enclosed work areas
requirements.text: Enclosed work areas should have conventional entrances and exits for routine access and unrestricted flow of traffic and equipment; located so personnel entering/leaving will not inadvertently operate or block controls or displays or interfere with ongoing work (5.11.7.1.3).
requirements.site_hook: Distance from door swing / entry path to control and display objects.

requirements.title: Exit illumination level
requirements.text: The illumination level of an exit shall be not less than 11 lux (1 foot-candle) at the walking surface.

values.quantity: illuminance at walking surface of exit

requirements.site_hook: User-entered illuminance.

requirements.title: Hinged door clear width
requirements.text: Hinged doors shall have at least the dimensions shown on figure 82 (5.11.7.2.1): door width 810 - 860 mm (32 - 34 in).
requirements.site_hook: Sandbox door width; also compare with clothed P99 max body breadth.

requirements.title: Hinged door height
requirements.text: Door height 2.0 - 2.1 m (6.6 - 6.9 ft).
requirements.site_hook: Sandbox door height; also compare with P99 stature + footwear/helmet.

requirements.title: Door hinge-side clearance to wall
requirements.text: Figure 82 shows 100 - 300 mm (4 - 12 in) between the door at the hinge side and the perpendicular wall.

values.quantity: hinge-side clearance from door to perpendicular wall

requirements.site_hook: Distance from door hinge edge to adjacent wall object.

requirements.title: Side-hinged doors in exit routes
requirements.text: Side-hinged doors shall be used in exit routes.
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Inward door clearance to perpendicular wall
requirements.text: When a door opens inward next to a perpendicular wall, a clearance of at least 100 mm (4 in) shall be provided between the door at the hinge and the plane of the wall (text cites figure 83; the dimension is drawn on figure 82).

values.condition: door opens inward next to perpendicular wall

requirements.site_hook: Distance from door hinge to wall object.

requirements.title: Equipment clear of inward door swing
requirements.text: Equipment or furniture shall not be positioned within 75 mm (3 in) of the swing path of a door that opens inward (see figure 82).

values.quantity: clearance from door swing path to equipment/furniture

requirements.site_hook: Door swing arc vs nearest sandbox object distance.

requirements.title: Door opening direction by traffic density
requirements.text: When normal and emergency exiting traffic density is low, hinged doors shall open inward rather than outward into a corridor; when exiting traffic volume is high, the door shall have a see-through window and open outward (5.11.7.2.5.2).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist / door swing direction parameter.

requirements.title: Alternative door types
requirements.text: With sliding/folding doors for large equipment, alternative personnel exits (hinged door) should be available (5.11.7.3.1, .1.1, .1.2); swinging doors should be used in pairs with a center post (5.11.7.3.2) and have windows (5.11.7.3.3); spring closers only where size/weight prevents manual operation (5.11.7.3.4); revolving doors should not be used (5.11.7.3.5).
requirements.site_hook: Checklist.

requirements.title: Whole body access - top and bottom access openings
requirements.text: Rectangular hatches shall meet the minimum whole body access dimensions of figure 83 (5.11.7.5.7); whole body access dimensions shall meet or exceed figure 83 (5.11.7.6.1). Top and bottom access: light clothing A 330 mm (13 in), B 580 mm (23 in); bulky clothing A 410 mm (16 in), B 690 mm (27 in). Dimensions are based on male data.
